title: Lead Network Engineer - Hybrid Load Balancer
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Lead Network Engineer** to standardize, optimize, and manage the lifecycle of enterprise load-balancing platforms across physical, virtual, cloud, and container environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Design end-to-end hybrid load balancing architectures to securely distribute client requests across on-premises servers, private clouds, and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Configure and manage advanced load balancing algorithms such as Round Robin, Least Connections, IP Hash, and Geo-proximity/Latency-based routing
* Administer enterprise ADC and load balancing platforms, including F5 BIG-IP (LTM, GTM/DNS, ASM, APM), VMware Avi Load Balancer (NSX Advanced LB), and native cloud balancers (AWS ALB/NLB, Azure Front Door/Load Balancer)
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, or Python/Bash scripts to automate load balancer provisioning, certificate rotation, and policy updates
* Ensure SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle management, web application firewall (WAF) integration, DDoS mitigation, and secure traffic policies across hybrid perimeters
* Perform L3/L4 root-cause analyses to maintain platform reliability and troubleshoot complex network issues

**Requirements**

* 8-12 years of total experience in network engineering, including a minimum of 5 years of F5 engineering experience
* Expertise in F5 BIG-IP (LTM, DNS, VE)
* Skills in HAProxy design and tuning
* Familiarity with Kubernetes ingress controllers
* Knowledge of Azure and AWS cloud-native load balancers
* Proficiency in automation using Ansible, Python, or Terraform

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Support Engineering Intern
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world's critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

**The Position**

We are looking for a Support Engineering Intern to join our Level 1 technical support team for six months. You will work alongside experienced engineers on live customer cases: investigating issues, reproducing them in lab environments, and helping customers deploy and configure our products. This is not a shadowing program. From your first weeks you will own real tickets, with a mentor beside you.

We are especially interested in people who are curious about AI and automation. Every case we handle is different, and getting to an answer means digging through logs, documentation, and past investigations. AI and good internal tooling can make that work sharper and faster — better search across our knowledge base, quicker log analysis, cleaner first drafts of technical documentation. If that is something you enjoy exploring, you will have room to experiment here and a team that will adopt what proves useful.

**What You'll Do**

**Customer Issue Management**

* Work the queue of open support tickets alongside your mentor, helping ensure timely resolution.

* Investigate and diagnose reported technical issues — gather information, reproduce the problem, and narrow down the cause.

* Search internal knowledge systems (FAQs, troubleshooting guides, past tickets, product documentation, internal wikis) to find solutions before escalating.

* Escalate complex cases to senior engineers with clear, well-documented troubleshooting notes.

* Communicate clearly and professionally with customers via email, chat, and ticketing tools.

**Technical Assistance & Troubleshooting**

* Help customers with installation, configuration, and integration of OPSWAT products.

* Build and maintain lab environments used to reproduce customer scenarios.

* Work with Product, Engineering, and QA teams to get to the bottom of technical challenges.

**AI & Automation (where you can make a mark)**

* Identify repetitive, manual steps in the daily support workflow and propose ways to automate them.

* Use AI assistants responsibly to speed up research, draft case summaries, and produce first-pass knowledge base content — always with human review before anything reaches a customer..

* Help the team evaluate AI-assisted support tooling and share what works and what doesn't.

* Contribute to prompt libraries, internal documentation, and reusable templates the wider support organization can use.

**Documentation & Knowledge Sharing**

* Keep accurate records of customer interactions and resolutions in the ticketing system.

* Write and update knowledge base articles, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides.

**Learning & Growth**

* Complete OPSWAT product and cybersecurity training, including certifications through the OPSWAT Academy.
* Keep up with product updates, new features, and security industry developments.

**What We're Looking For**

*You do not need professional experience. We care far more about how you think and how quickly you learn.*

* Currently studying toward a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field — or a recent graduate.

* Available for the full 6 months, at least 30 hours per week.

* Comfortable with Windows and Linux: you can navigate a filesystem, read a log, install software, and use a terminal without hesitation.

* Basic understanding of networking — TCP/IP, DNS, ports, firewalls.

* Strong analytical instincts: you like breaking a problem apart rather than guessing at it.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Genuine curiosity about AI and automation — and ideally, something you have already built or automated, even if small. A script, a bot, a hobby project, a workflow you tidied up. We would love to hear about it.

* A collaborative attitude and the confidence to ask questions early.

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with AI tools — ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar — applied to real tasks rather than just tried out.

* Scripting or automation experience in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

* Familiarity with ticketing systems (Jira, Zendesk, ServiceNow, Salesforce Service Cloud).

* Basic understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

* Interest in cybersecurity concepts: malware analysis, threat detection, secure file transfer, or OT/ICS environments.

* Personal projects, hackathons, CTFs, or open-source contributions.

OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

title: Escalations Technical Leader
description:

Join a dynamic, globally distributed group of technical program managers and escalation specialists who lead the charge on major security incidents and customer escalations. Our team is at the heart of Cisco’s unified security platform, partnering closely with engineering, product, support, and account teams to ensure customers are protected and critical issues are resolved quickly. With a dozen talented professionals based in San Jose and around the world, the team thrives on collaboration, ownership, and a fast-paced, high-impact environment. You'll work alongside distinguished engineers and leaders, interact directly with customer executives, and help shape the future of our security products. If you’re excited to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and make a tangible difference for customers and the business, this team is the place to be.

Drive the response to major incidents and complex customer escalations to ensure rapid restoration of critical services and customer satisfaction. Coordinate cross-functional teams, assign actions, track progress, and deliver timely updates to stakeholders, minimising risk and business disruption. Prepare operational reports, outage summaries, and follow-up actions to promote transparency and continual improvement. Partner with Problem Management to document root causes and implement corrective measures, preventing repeat incidents. Lead post-incident reviews, develop and refine playbooks, and leverage automation to enhance efficiency and organizational readiness. Success in this role means consistently resolving high-impact issues, improving incident management processes, and helping shape the reliability and resilience of Cisco's security platform.
  
  

* Lead P1/P2 incidents and complex customer escalations, coordinating cross-functional teams through resolution.
* Drive action tracking, ownership, stakeholder communication, and risk mitigation.
* Lead post-incident reviews, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Improve incident-management processes, playbooks, governance, and operational reporting.
* Conduct crisis simulations and tabletop exercises to strengthen readiness.
* Leverage automation and AI to enhance incident response and prevent recurring issues.
* Mentor incident managers and engineers.
* Partner with Architecture, Product, and Engineering to improve reliability, resilience, and observability.
* Drive continuous improvement and define strategic priorities for incident management.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree and 15 years of related experience, Master’s degree and 8 years, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience in major incident management, technical support, customer escalation management, site reliability, or a related field.
* Experience leading P1/P2 incidents and complex customer issues through resolution or formal handoff.
* Experience coordinating Support, Engineering, Product, Account Teams, and leadership during critical incidents.
* Experience with incident tracking and customer-management tools such as Jira and Salesforce.
* Experience documenting root cause, corrective actions, and follow-up work.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with Splunk Security products, including Splunk Enterprise Security, SOAR, XDR, EDR, or related cybersecurity technologies.
* Experience with cloud platforms, Kubernetes, APIs, networking, observability, or distributed systems.
* Ability to read or troubleshoot code in Python, Java, C++, Go, or a similar language.
* ITIL certification or experience applying ITIL incident, problem, change, and continual-improvement practices.
* Experience using automation, AIOps, or AI-enabled incident-management tools.
* Experience leading work across multiple regions and time zones.

title: Senior Project Management Business Partner - PM Method and Performance Specialist
description:
**Job Description:**

**Shape the Future of Airbus with Us!**

  

By joining the global **Airbus BC (Cross-Programme)** organization as a founding member of the newly created **Airbus PM Office in India** , you will play a pivotal role in operating projects, programmes, portfolios, and performance management to enable efficient decision-making and execution with a high level of **PM standard.**

  

We are looking for passionate talent, whether you want to **develop your Project Management skills toward seniority** or are **an experienced PM Expert ready to mentor and innovate** , to help us reshape the future of Aircraft programmes through PM excellence .

  

Driven by an entrepreneurial mindset and our Vision 2028 ambition to build an autonomous, high-performing PM Team in India, our mission rests on three core pillars:

* **Driving PM Excellence & Global Competitiveness** : Enabling strategic impact and operational standards locally.
* **Delivering Smart PM Digital Ecosystem:** Deploying data-driven solutions and optimizing cost structures.
* **Ensuring Seamless PMBP Experience & Beyond:** Simplifying ways of working across Airbus India and broader BC activities.

  

In this role, you will be directly embedded in the **ERP Transformation Program** , one of Airbus’s most strategic enterprise initiatives, and the Digital PM Office (BCXX). We are modernizing and simplifying our legacy landscape of over 110 SAP instances, shifting to a standardized, Clean Core S/4HANA Cloud platform.

  

Our ambition is to turn our ERP into a high-velocity engine powered by embedded AI, advanced analytics, and real-time data continuity.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to harmonize end-to-end business processes, deploy reusable assets, and drive structured governance across a global portfolio of execution projects.

  

As a PM specialist within this programme, you will co-pilot critical operations, streamline execution routines, and help pave the way for the future of digital operations at Airbus.

  

**Come sharpen your craft, unleash your potential, and build the future with us!**

**About the Role**

Are you driven to eliminate ambiguity and establish clarity across complex enterprise portfolios? In this strategic role, you will lead global performance tracking and methodology standardization for ERP Accelerator Operations. You will empower transnational teams with robust hybrid frameworks, unified toolkits, and data-driven governance to accelerate value creation and deliver predictable, high-performing outcomes.

  

The **Project Management Methods and Performance Specialist** (d/f/m) serves as a core structuring governance and methodology lead within ERP Accelerator Operations. Responsible for eliminating ambiguity and establishing end-to-end operational transparency, this role drives global performance tracking and accelerates business transformation through scalable, standardized Project Management (PM) solutions.

  

He bridges traditional enterprise governance with modern iterative frameworks, enforcing robust project lifecycles across a Hybrid methodology environment (Waterfall/LBiP & Agile/SAFe) to ensure seamless delivery, predictability, and performance alignment across transnational teams.

  

**Key Accountabilities & Main Responsibilities**

* Structuring Governance & Performance Tracking:
  + Define, establish, and maintain a standardized global performance tracking framework to drive transparency and remove operational ambiguities across ERP Accelerator Operations.
  + Establish baseline metrics, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Objective & Key Results , and health dashboards to track progress across all release trains and work packages as part of the Airbus Process ((MC.PI.02 / MC.RP.02).
  + Lead governance routines, performance reviews, and executive reporting cycles for transnational stakeholders.
* Hybrid Methodology Enforcer & Standardizer (Waterfall/LBiP & Agile/SAFe):
  + Architect, deploy, and enforce standardized PM standards and lifecycle controls bridging Waterfall / LBIP (Launch-Base Implementation Process) governance with Agile / SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) execution.
  + Define clear interaction models between traditional milestone gates (LBIP) and SAFe Program Increments (PI Planning), System Demos, and Value Stream alignments.
  + Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on PM standards, providing coaching and guidelines to Release Train Engineers (RTEs), Product Managers, PMBPs, and Work Package Leaders.
* Operational Acceleration & Scalable PM Solutions:
  + Design and roll out scalable, reusable PM toolkits, templates, and automated workflows that streamline project administration and shorten cycle times.
  + Identify operational bottlenecks, continuous improvement opportunities, and process gaps across ERP Accelerator workstreams to accelerate transformation delivery.
  + Facilitate change management initiatives to secure high adoption of standardized PM practices across global delivery centers.
* Digital Tooling and Data Integrity:
  + Secure single-source-of-truth data integrity across the PM digital ecosystem, establishing automated data validation rules between Agile tracking tools and enterprise portfolio systems.
  + Champion "PM Governance" by integrating predictive analytics to identify performance drift, schedule variance, and delivery risks before they impact target milestones.
  Propose automation of repetitive status reporting, data aggregation, and compliance auditing using advanced analytics and AI capabilities.

  

**Dimensions**

* Scope of Impact: Global governance footprint across ERP Accelerator Operations and BCX PM Office initiatives (Europe, India, and global deployment sites).
* Stakeholder Network: Direct interface with ERP Operations Executives, Value Stream Owners, Release Train Engineers, PM Office Leaders, and Transnational PMBPs.
Methodology Scope: Oversight of hybrid delivery models managing multi-million-euro digital enterprise transformations.  

  

**Desired skills and qualifications**

* Experience: 7–10+ years of proven experience in Project Management Governance, Methods & Processes, and Performance Management within complex, transnational IT/ERP or aerospace engineering environments.
* SAP Activate & Hybrid Framework Mastery: Require demonstrated experience in defining or enforcing hybrid PM methodologies combining SAP Activate (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run) with enterprise Agile/SAFe or Waterfall/LBIP frameworks.
* SAP configuration or Technical Expertise is not required but instead PM process governance for large-scale enterprise ERP/SAP transformations is.
* Process Harmonization & Quality Gate Knowledge:
Excellent stakeholder engagement and negotiation skills with fluent English language Proficiency.  

  

**Certifications** :

* SAFe Agilist (SA), SAFe Practice Consultant (SPC), or SAFe POPM / RTE certification, STE is highly valued.
* PMI-PMP, or PM Certification (Bronze/Silver).
Lean Six Sigma is a plus.  

  

**Competencies** :

* PM Processes, Methods, tools (Expert)
* PM Operations & Performance (Advanced)
* AGILE & SAFe Framework Implementation (Advanced)
* Project Portfolio Management & Governance (Advanced)
* Risk & Opportunity Management Execution (Autonomous)
Stakeholder Management & Executive Alignment (Advanced)  

  

**Soft Skills:** Exceptional analytical capability, executive presentation skills, structured problem-solving, strategic negotiation, and natural influence without direct authority.

  

**Languages** : Fluent / Negotiation level English (mandatory). German, French is a plus

  

**Technical Stack & Tooling**

* Agile & Work Management: Jira, Agility, SAFe Launchpad
* Enterprise PM & Portfolio: Planisware (E7 / Enterprise), Zoho
* Analytics & Performance Dashboards: Qlik Sense, PowerBI, Palantir (Skywise)
* Risk & Quality Management: ARM (Active Risk Manager)
Digital Workplace & Automation: Google Workspace, Gemini AI  

  

**Your Benefits**

* Challenging tasks and unique high-tech products and services
* Good work-life balance in a big international company
* Actively lived values "We are one", diversity really matters
* On-the-job trainings for personal development and technical skills
* Mentoring programmes
* Flexible working hours and working time compensation
* Home office is possible
* Compatibility of family and career
Attractive salary and company benefits  

  

**Your Location**

* Site-based position with hybrid working options

title: Senior Project Management Business Partner For Single Aisle Programme
description:
**Job Description:**

**Shape the Future of Airbus with Us!**

  

By joining the global **Airbus BC (Cross-Programme)** organization as a founding member of the newly created **Airbus PM Office in India** , you will play a pivotal role in operating projects, programmes, portfolios, and performance management to enable efficient decision-making and execution with a high level of **PM standard.**

  

We are looking for passionate talent, whether you want to **develop your Project Management skills toward seniority** or are **an experienced PM Expert ready to mentor and innovate** , to help us reshape the future of Aircraft programmes through PM excellence .

  

Driven by an entrepreneurial mindset and our Vision 2028 ambition to build an autonomous, high-performing PM Team in India, our mission rests on three core pillars:

* **Driving PM Excellence & Global Competitiveness** : Enabling strategic impact and operational standards locally.
* **Delivering Smart PM Digital Ecosystem:** Deploying data-driven solutions and optimizing cost structures.
* **Ensuring Seamless PMBP Experience & Beyond:** Simplifying ways of working across Airbus India and broader BC activities.

  

In this role, you will be directly embedded in the **Single Aisle (A320 Family) PM Office** , supporting the flagship backbone of Airbus Commercial.

  

As part of the BCS team, you will drive PM Operational excellence and robust PM Governance across key A320 Family Business or Industrial projects.

We focus on spreading a strong PM culture within a trustful, inclusive, and empowering environment where transparency, collaboration, speak-up, and feedback are highly valued.

  

From maintaining master schedules and managing risks to deploying high-accuracy data control, real-time performance dashboards, and smart PM automation, you will co-pilot critical programme milestones, enable data-driven decision-making, and directly contribute to the ongoing success of Airbus's most iconic aircraft family!

  

**Come sharpen your craft, unleash your potential, and build the future with us!**

  

**About the Role**

Are you passionate about turning project data into strategic business value? In this role, you will

provide autonomous project management support across complex initiatives. By delivering and analyzing integrated schedules, budgets, and risk profiles, you will deliver predictive performance insights that optimize project delivery.

  

The **Project Management Business Partner (PMBP)** is an execution-focused PM specialist embedded within project teams to drive day-to-day project performance. Accountable for maintaining project schedule baselines, generating real-time performance dashboards, tracking risks, and enforcing standardized PM methods, the PMBP bridges technical project execution with strategic business objectives

  

**Key Accountabilities & Main Responsibilities**

* Project Execution & Operational Support:
  + Provide expert project management support across complex initiatives to secure baseline execution: daily project schedule structures, resource loading, and cost monitoring in accordance with Airbus PM standards (e.g., MP.PP.01/02).
  + Maintain Top-Down / Bottom-Up planning synchronization within single-source-of-truth systems.
  + Track milestone maturity, quality gates, and deliverables against time, cost, quality, and performance target
* Performance Management & Data Analytics:
  + Define, develop, and maintain integrated PM dashboards and project status reports for internal stakeholders.
  + Leverage data analytics to perform data sanity checks, monitor planning adherence, and proactively flag potential project delays before they occur.
  + Secure Planisware data integrity as the Single Source of Truth
* Core PM Governance & Risk Tracking:
  + Facilitate project routines, steering meetings, risk reviews, and decision-making workshops.
  + Execute Risk & Opportunity management processes (ARM), log mitigation action plans, and maintain project registers.
  + Support the capture of lessons learned and process improvement feedback loops.
* Process Standardization & AI Adoption:
  + Promote a "Digital-First" mindset by actively identifying repetitive PM tasks for automation.
  Utilize AI tools to summarize technical alignment meetings, draft executive status updates, and track operational action items.

  

**Dimensions**

* Team Leadership: Individual contributor role; coordinates project work packages, cross-functional contributors, and local subcontractor task units.
* Stakeholder Network: Direct operational interfaces with Project Leaders, Engineers, Domain Experts and Transnational Project Contributors.
Scope: Dedicated support to specific project work packages or domain portfolios  

  

**Desired skills and qualifications**

* Educated to a Degree level in Business Administration, Engineering, Project Management, or an equivalent field.
* Solid professional experience 3 to 5+ years in applied project management across traditional Waterfall and Agile environments.
* Proven experience with enterprise scheduling tools for baseline control, resource

planning, and schedule tracking.

dashboarding tools.

Excellent stakeholder engagement and negotiation skills with fluent English language Proficiency.

title: Sr. Escalation Engineer
description:
Meet the Team
  
Join a dynamic, globally distributed group of technical program managers and escalation specialists who lead the charge on major security incidents and customer escalations. Our team is at the heart of Cisco’s unified security platform, partnering closely with engineering, product, support, and account teams to ensure customers are protected and critical issues are resolved quickly. With a dozen talented professionals based in San Jose and around the world, the team thrives on collaboration, ownership, and a fast-paced, high-impact environment. You'll work alongside distinguished engineers and leaders, interact directly with customer executives, and help shape the future of our security products. If you’re excited to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and make a tangible difference for customers and the business, this team is the place to be.
  
  
Your Impact
  
Drive the response to major incidents and complex customer escalations to
  
ensure rapid restoration of critical services and customer satisfaction. Coordinate cross-functional teams, assign actions, track progress, and deliver timely updates to stakeholders, minimizing risk and business disruption. Prepare operational reports, outage summaries, and follow-up actions to promote transparency and continual improvement. Partner with Problem Management to document root causes and implement corrective measures, preventing repeat incidents. Lead post-incident reviews, develop and refine playbooks, and leverage automation to enhance efficiency and organizational readiness. Success in this role means consistently resolving high-impact issues, improving incident management processes, and helping shape the reliability and resilience of Cisco's security platform.
  
  

* Lead P1/P2 incidents and complex customer escalations from intake to resolution or handoff, coordinating cross-functional teams and leadership.
* Assign actions, track progress, remove blockers, and provide timely, accurate stakeholder updates.
* Assess risks, drive mitigation plans, and lead post-incident reviews, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Develop and improve incident-management processes, playbooks, governance, and operational reporting.
* Lead crisis simulations and tabletop exercises to strengthen organizational readiness.
* Leverage automation and AI tools to improve incident response and prevent recurring issues.
* Mentor incident managers and engineers while partnering with Architecture, Product, and Engineering to enhance reliability, resilience, and observability.
* Drive continuous improvement and define strategic priorities for incident management across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree and 10 years of related experience, Master’s degree and 8 years, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience in major incident management, technical support, customer escalation management, site reliability, or a related field.
* Experience leading P1/P2 incidents and complex customer issues through resolution or formal handoff.
* Experience coordinating Support, Engineering, Product, Account Teams, and leadership during critical incidents.
* Experience with incident tracking and customer-management tools such as Jira and Salesforce.
* Experience documenting root cause, corrective actions, and follow-up work.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with Splunk Security products, including Splunk Enterprise Security, SOAR, XDR, EDR, or related cybersecurity technologies.
* Experience with cloud platforms, Kubernetes, APIs, networking, observability, or distributed systems.
* Ability to read or troubleshoot code in Python, Java, C++, Go, or a similar language.
* ITIL certification or experience applying ITIL incident, problem, change, and continual-improvement practices.
* Experience using automation, AIOps, or AI-enabled incident-management tools.
* Experience leading work across multiple regions and time zones.
* Ability to communicate clearly and make decisions during high-pressure situations.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Associate Director - SAP Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal SAP Infrastructure Engineer builds and runs both the Cloud and On-Prem SAP Infrastructure platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 8-10 years in cloud and SAP infrastructure, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience in cloud infrastructure management, preferably with ERP systems.
* Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on either Azure or Google Cloud
* Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on VMware
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert)

  

* Knowledge of networking, security, and compliance in cloud environments.

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

API Management, Application Infrastructure, Automation, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Platform Development, Reliability Engineering, SAP Infrastructure, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. title: Lead Network Engineer - SD-WAN & AIOps Specialist
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Lead Network Engineer – SD-WAN & AIOps Specialist** to drive Cisco SD-WAN platform integration, telemetry, observability, and automation initiatives across enterprise and cloud environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement end-to-end management of Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN architecture, including core control plane components: Cisco SD-WAN Manager (vManage), Controller (vSmart), Validator (vBond), and Edge routers (cEdge/vEdge)
* Drive Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP) and Plug-and-Play (PnP) templates to scale deployments across campuses, branches, and colocation facilities
* Configure Cisco Cloud OnRamp for SaaS and IaaS to deliver optimized application path selection and multi-cloud connectivity
* Maintain service uptime guidelines by managing control component certificates, on-demand snapshots, and automated software upgrades
* Integrate AI/ML capability frameworks within Cisco Catalyst Center (DNA Center) and Cisco ThousandEyes to establish deep visibility and predictive problem mitigation
* Automate Day-0 to Day-N configuration tasks using Python, Ansible, and Terraform via Cisco SDKs and REST APIs
* Leverage telemetry data, NetFlow, and streaming logs to build predictive baselines, optimize bandwidth usage, and forecast capacity
* Embed Security-by-Design principles using application-aware routing, micro-segmentation, zones, and centralized SASE structures
* Configure and troubleshoot complex Layer 2 and Layer 3 policies, including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, BFD, QoS, and IPsec/GRE encapsulation

**Requirements**

title: Director- Digital Platforms and Integration
description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose**

The Director, Digital Platforms & Integration is accountable for defining, delivering and continuously evolving the foundational digital platforms, integration capabilities and information frameworks that enable GSK's future smart manufacturing, supply chain and CMC digital ecosystem.

The role leads the strategy, execution and operational performance of the Factory Integration Layer (FIL) as a critical enterprise capability connecting manufacturing systems, laboratory platforms, engineering applications, cloud services and business processes. The position ensures that platform and integration investments create reusable, scalable and technology-agnostic capabilities that accelerate business outcomes across sites, functions and products.

The Director is accountable for the Azure Local migration strategy, establishing a modern, secure and resilient hybrid foundation for digital products, analytics, AI and industrial data solutions across the manufacturing network.

As a key leader within the CMC Acceleration Program, the role owns delivery and integration of enterprise ontologies, knowledge-management capabilities, data pipelines and information architectures that transform fragmented data into connected, contextualized and actionable knowledge. The position enables digital thread capabilities across development, technology transfer, manufacturing, quality and supply chain operations.

Working with Product Leaders, Business Process Owners, Architects, Data & AI teams, Manufacturing Technology leaders and strategic partners, the Director aligns multiple transformation initiatives while ensuring solutions remain scalable, compliant, supportable and aligned to enterprise standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute the strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for the Factory Integration Layer, creating a scalable digital backbone connecting manufacturing, laboratory, quality, engineering, data and enterprise platforms.
* Establish FIL as a reusable enterprise capability through standard integration patterns, event-driven services, APIs, information models and repeatable site-onboarding approaches.
* Lead Azure Local migration across relevant manufacturing and operational workloads, ensuring secure cutover, continuity, validation, resilience and sustainable product and service ownership.
* Own Digital Platforms & Integration deliverables for the CMC Acceleration Program, translating development, technology-transfer and manufacturing priorities into integrated platform outcomes.
* Lead the creation and operational adoption of enterprise ontologies, semantic models and common information definitions that connect product, process, material, equipment, recipe and manufacturing knowledge.
* Lead the team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and ensuring compliance with GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
* Integrate knowledge-management capabilities across scientific, development and manufacturing domains to improve information discoverability, reuse, traceability and knowledge continuity.
* Define platform governance, architecture guardrails, decision rights and performance measures covering adoption, reliability, throughput, latency, data quality, service effort, security and value realization.
* Scan emerging platform, integration and edge capability (vendor roadmaps, new releases), pilot the most promising and bring a ranked opportunity list into the investment forums.
* Own material delivery and operational risks, ensuring appropriate governance for cyber security, data protection, quality, validation, regulatory compliance and business continuity.
* Sponsor operational readiness for major releases and migrations, integrating support models, training, documentation, deployment, monitoring, service transition and user adoption.
* Shape strategic supplier contributions and resolve delivery, quality, commercial or capability issues affecting multiple platforms, products, sites or programs.
* Represent digital platforms, integration health, dependencies, risks and investment impacts in senior product, architecture, data, cyber and transformation governance forums.
* Build a high-performing, inclusive community of platform, integration and data professionals, strengthening engineering excellence, product ownership and continuous improvement.

**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Professional qualifications in cloud, enterprise architecture, integration, data management, product management, agile delivery, service management or cyber security are desirable.
* Typically 15+ years of experience in enterprise technology, digital manufacturing, integration platforms, cloud technologies, data platforms or digital transformation, including leadership of complex or regulated capabilities.
* Proven accountability for enterprise-scale platform strategy, roadmap, delivery, adoption and lifecycle management with material business, operational and risk impact.
* Experience leading Factory Integration Layer, industrial integration, OT/IT convergence, edge computing or comparable manufacturing-platform capabilities.
* Experience leading Azure Local, hybrid-cloud or edge-infrastructure migration, including architecture, security, validation, cutover, operational readiness and service transition.
* Demonstrated delivery of ontologies, semantic models, knowledge graphs, knowledge-management integrations, data pipelines or digital-thread capabilities.
* Experience leading multiple Product Owners, Architects, Engineers, Data specialists or delivery workstreams and establishing clear decision rights and technical guardrails.
* Demonstrated ability to resolve strategic trade-offs across value, cost, capacity, architecture, data, cyber security, compliance and business continuity.
* Experience influencing Director and VP stakeholders and representing platform delivery in investment, architecture, data, risk and transformation forums.
* Strong experience managing cross-platform dependencies, supplier contributions, complex migrations and global release sequencing.
* Experience strengthening ways of working, coaching technical talent and building sustainable platform, integration and knowledge-management capabilities.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Enterprise architecture and systems thinking, with the ability to connect business capability, information, integration, infrastructure and service views.
* Executive communication and confidence operating in senior governance forums.
* Deep understanding of integration patterns, APIs, event streaming, industrial connectivity and contextualized data flows.
* Working knowledge of Azure Local, hybrid infrastructure, edge computing, containers and platform engineering practices.
* Knowledge of ontologies, semantic technologies, knowledge graphs, metadata and knowledge-management principles.
* Analytical judgement to balance value, risk, cost, complexity, urgency and operational impact.
* Strong organisation, traceability, documentation and decision-management discipline.
* Ability to lead global, cross-functional and supplier teams through ambiguity and complex dependencies.
* Commitment to user-centred, capability-led and technology-agnostic solutions.
* Passion for engineering excellence, responsible AI enablement, smart manufacturing and continuous improvement.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

title: Principal Engineer - Data Engineering Architect
description:
**About This Role**

Wells Fargo is seeking a **Principal Engineer / Architect ( Data Engineering** )to define and advance the data information strategy, information models, data sourcing standards, and data enablement roadmap across Enterprise Risk, Audit, and Finance Technology.

This is a horizontal architecture role supporting multiple business and technology domains, including Financial Risk, Non-Financial Risk, Finance, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting, Internal Audit, Independent Testing, Model Risk, and Financial Crimes.

The role will shape how enterprise information is identified, defined, sourced, modeled, governed, integrated, and made consumable across ERAFT. The role will establish common information models, semantic standards, authoritative-source guidance, reusable data products, and architecture patterns that enable consistent reporting, analytics, regulatory traceability, and artificial intelligence use cases.

The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of information architecture, enterprise data architecture, financial-services and banking domain knowledge, data governance, sourcing strategy, semantic modeling, integration design, analytics enablement, and stakeholder leadership. This individual must be able to work independently, influence decisions across business and technology teams, and translate complex business, regulatory, and technology requirements into practical and scalable data architecture.

**In This Role, You Will**

  

* Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Translate advanced technology experience, an in-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions
* Provide vision, direction and expertise to leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions
* Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies and recommends innovations that enhance operations or provide a competitive advantage to the organization
* Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership.

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 7+ years of experience in data architecture, information architecture, enterprise architecture, information modeling, or data-platform design.

* 7+ years of experience supporting banking, financial services, finance, risk, audit, regulatory reporting, compliance, or control-related domains.
* Strong Experience in APIs, Kafka or event streaming, ETL and ELT, data virtualization, data lakes, lakehouse platforms, and enterprise data warehouses.
* Experience with technologies such as Dremio, Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, Python, SQL, Neo4J, Protégé, object storage, and metadata or catalog platforms.

**Desired Qualifications:**

**Data Information Strategy and Architecture**

* Define and own the data information strategy and target-state information architecture across ERAFT.
* Develop current-state, target-state, and transition-state architectures covering information domains, data sourcing, information models, metadata, lineage, data products, semantic access, integration, and consumption.
* Define canonical information models and common business concepts that can be reused across Risk, Finance, Audit, regulatory reporting, analytics, and AI use cases.
* Establish standards and artifacts for conceptual and logical data models, taxonomies, ontologies, business glossaries, source-to-target mappings, data flows, data lineage views, and semantic relationships.
* Align ERAFT information architecture with enterprise data, metadata, privacy, security, retention, records-management, and regulatory standards.
* Define architecture principles that enable common information to be understood and reused while allowing justified domain-specific extensions.
* Produce architecture specifications, decision records, reference models, roadmaps, standards, and executive-level recommendations.
* Develop POC’s and demos to supplement architecture materials.

**Data Sourcing Strategy**

* Define reusable data sourcing strategies across ERAFT business and technology domains.
* Identify authoritative systems of record, systems of reference, authoritative distribution sources, and trusted consumption sources for critical enterprise information.
* Establish criteria for selecting the appropriate sourcing approach, including direct-source integration, authoritative data products, APIs, event streams, batch feeds, data warehouses, data lakes, data virtualization, federated queries, and metadata-driven ingestion.
* Define sourcing patterns for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured information.
* Partner with source-system owners, data owners, and data stewards to assess data availability, ownership, quality, lineage, refresh frequency, historical coverage, access restrictions, and regulatory obligations.
* Determine whether information should be physically ingested, virtually accessed, indexed, summarized, referenced, or exposed through a governed data product.
* Reduce duplicate sourcing, unnecessary data movement, point-to-point integration, and inconsistent transformation logic.
* Define data contracts that document schema, semantics, quality expectations, service levels, usage constraints, and change-management responsibilities between producers and consumers.

**Information Modeling and Semantic Alignment**

* Develop and maintain enterprise and domain-level information models across ERAFT.
* Standardize business concepts, definitions, relationships, taxonomies, and metrics across Risk, Finance, Audit, and related regulatory domains.
* Define semantic relationships among customers, accounts, products, transactions, legal entities, positions, risks, controls, models, obligations, issues, findings, evidence, business processes, reports, and organizational structures.
* Partner with business data owners and governance teams to approve common definitions and resolve semantic conflicts.
* Support subject-area taxonomy alignment, conceptual modeling, glossary analysis, ontology evaluation, and capability mapping.
* Define semantic-layer patterns that separate business meaning from physical data structures and technology implementations.
* Evaluate ontology and knowledge-graph approaches where they improve cross-domain discovery, traceability, impact analysis, aggregation, or AI-enabled access.
* Promote reuse of common information concepts while preserving appropriate business context for individual domains.

**Data Governance, Quality, Metadata, and Lineage**

* Define information-governance requirements for ERAFT data products, platforms, and solutions.
* Partner with data owners and stewards to establish accountability for business terms, data domains, data products, and Critical Data Elements.
* Define data-quality expectations for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, validity, consistency, and uniqueness.
* Establish patterns for data controls, reconciliation, validation, observability, and issue remediation.
* Define end-to-end lineage requirements from authoritative sources through ingestion, transformation, semantic models, reports, analytics, models, AI solutions, and downstream consumers.

* Experience spanning multiple Risk, Finance, Audit, Treasury, Financial Crimes, Model Risk, regulatory, or enterprise data-management domains.

title: AI Platform Engineer II
description:
**Job Purpose :**

  

As Enterprise AI’s delivery portfolio grows and GenAI and agentic solutions move from pilot to production, the platform must scale reliably and safely. The AI Platform Engineer owns significant areas of that platform — ensuring they operate at SLO, building automation against routine operations work, embedding security and responsible AI controls into the platform layer, and contributing to the vendor and standards conversations that shape the platform’s direction.

* **Owns significant platform areas** with genuine accountability for reliability, security, performance, and cost efficiency of AI services — not just task execution.
* **Makes AI consumable at enterprise scale** by operating the gateways, model endpoints, and context services through which every team reaches models, tools, and data.
* **Builds platform leverage** through automation, self-service, and reusable components that reduce manual operations work across the team.
* **Embeds governance by design** so that AI security, data protection, and responsible AI controls are enforced by the platform rather than negotiated project by project.
* **Develops the next generation** by mentoring junior and mid-level platform engineers, building team capability over time.

**Responsibilities**:

  

* At least 6 years of experience running SaaS, cloud, or platform-engineering services in a production setting, including at least 2 years operating AI/ML or GenAI workloads or services.
* Strong proficiency in Python; working proficiency in at least one additional language (for example, Go, TypeScript, or Java).
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container platforms, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform; Bicep a plus), GitOps, and modern CI/CD.
* Hands-on experience operating API gateways or AI/LLM gateways, including routing, rate limiting, authentication, and policy enforcement for AI traffic.
* Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic patterns — tool calling, orchestration, and agent frameworks — and of how context is retrieved, managed, and governed for LLM applications.
* Experience operating production services with defined SLOs, observability, and incident management.
* Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks AI Assistant) as a primary development mode.
* Solid understanding of identity and access management, secrets management, and data protection for cloud and AI services.

**Required skills:**

  

* **Platform & Cloud:** Kubernetes, containers, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, DevSecOps, platform reliability engineering, and at least one major cloud (Azure preferred) with multi-cloud and hybrid architecture awareness.
* **AI Gateway & API Management:** API gateway patterns, AI/LLM gateway architecture and operations, traffic management, and policy enforcement.
* **GenAI Operations:** LLM deployment, versioning, and monitoring; prompt and evaluation workflows; RAG architectures; vector search fundamentals.
* **MCP & Agents:** Model Context Protocol, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and an understanding of agent orchestration frameworks and context engineering.
* **Observability:** Metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting (for example, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or cloud-native equivalents) applied to AI services.
* **Security:** IAM, OAuth/OIDC, secrets management, network security, and data privacy controls for AI workloads.

**Education** :

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree in Computer Science, Distributed Systems, or SRE is advantageous.

**Preferred skills:**

* **Azure AI services** (Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry, Azure API Management), with AWS and GCP AI services (for example, Bedrock, Google Cloud AI platform) desired.
* **Model serving and GPU infrastructure:** inference runtimes (for example, vLLM, KServe, Triton), GPU scheduling, and autoscaling.
* **Vector and retrieval stacks:** vector databases and hybrid search (for example, pgvector, Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, or dedicated vector stores).
* **Agent and LLM frameworks:** LangChain/LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, or comparable; agent interoperability protocols; evaluation tooling.
* **Gateway technologies:** Kong AI Gateway or comparable (for example, Envoy-based gateways, LiteLLM, Portkey, Azure API Management).
* **Platform tooling:** Databricks, policy-as-code (OPA/Kyverno), service mesh, internal developer platforms (for example, Backstage), and FinOps for AI (token economics and unit-cost reporting).

**AI security & resilience:** guardrail frameworks, AI red-teaming, and resilience testing of AI services

AI Systems, Azure OpenAI Service, Google Cloud Document AI, Identity Access Management (IAM)

Responsibilities include setting engineering standards and SLOs; driving performance optimization, observability, reconciliation, and recovery; ensuring operational readiness and effective on-call coverage; and overseeing security, automation, and safe deployments and rollbacks. * Leads implementation and optimization initiatives across teams for approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
* Guides teams to design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

* Oversees the building and customization of moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health.

**System Design & Architecture – Correctness / Availability:**

**Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:**

**Compliance & Security:**

* Directs execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, promoting continuous improvement of security measures.
* Ensures comprehensive documentation and cloud infrastructure compliance with industry standards and regulations.

**Automation & Change Management:**

* Oversees the development and maintenance of automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
* Works with teams to create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and guides development of components to allow for automation of these processes.

* Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs.

* Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

description:
**Job Description: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer**

***Position Overview***

We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with at least 7 years of experience in full-stack software development, web crawling, network protocol analysis, and enterprise data telemetry. In this role, you will bridge the gap between application architecture, web scraper engineering, network traffic analysis, and data analytics.

Using Node.js as your primary backend environment, you will design automated crawling engines, analyze client-side rendering mechanics, monitor live application traffic in New Relic, and join web-level findings with data warehouse records to produce high-impact analytical reports.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Full-Stack Engineering & Web Crawling

Full-Stack Development: Architect, develop, and maintain robust services and analytics applications using Node.js (TypeScript/JavaScript) on the backend along with modern frontend frameworks.

Scalable Web Crawling: Design and scale high-throughput crawling suites using Node.js automation libraries (Playwright, Puppeteer) to inspect complex DOM structures, handle dynamic client-side rendering, and extract structured metadata.

DOM & Rendering Analysis: Evaluate the browser rendering lifecycle—including HTML/CSS parsing, JavaScript execution, DOM tree construction, layout, and visual paint—to detect client-side performance bottlenecks or script execution failures.

**2. HTTP Protocol & Network Traffic Analysis**

Network & Payload Inspection: Perform deep-dive analysis on inbound and outbound HTTP/HTTPS traffic, inspecting request/response headers, status codes, cookies, session tokens, payloads, and API endpoints.

APM & Traffic Patterns: Monitor real-time traffic volumes, request distribution, latency metrics, and error rates using New Relic (or equivalent APM systems) to detect operational anomalies and traffic spikes.

Full-Trace Mapping: Correlate client-side event triggers and tracking calls with server logs, microservice calls, and backend API responses.

**3. Data Warehouse Integration & Reporting**

Data Warehouse Querying: Write complex, optimized SQL queries and manage data pipelines to extract and aggregate large-scale records from platforms like Snowflake, BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift.

**Data Synthesis:** Merge web crawling datasets, HTTP payload logs, and APM telemetry with warehouse transaction history to perform root-cause analysis and pattern identification.

Technical Reporting: Build and deliver comprehensive technical reports, automated executive dashboards, and actionable recommendations for product, platform, and data teams.

**Required Qualifications**

Professional Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack software engineering, with a strong focus on backend systems, web scraping, and data-driven web analytics.

Node.js Expertise: 7+ years of deep technical proficiency in Node.js (TypeScript/JavaScript), microservices architecture, and asynchronous runtime performance tuning.

Frontend Mechanics: Master-level understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript runtime engines, browser rendering paths, DOM structures, and DevTools.

Browser Automation: Demonstrated track record building resilient, production-grade scrapers using Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium within a Node.js ecosystem.

Networking & Protocols: Expert knowledge of network protocols (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTPS), RESTful APIs, GraphQL, CORS, cookies, and HTTP request/response lifecycle mechanics.

Telemetry & APM: Hands-on expertise with New Relic or similar enterprise monitoring suites to analyze system performance, network payloads, and user traffic behavior.

**Preferred Qualifications**

5+ years in a senior or lead technical capacity guiding web architecture, data engineering pipelines, or scraping infrastructure.

Data Warehouse & SQL: Advanced SQL skills and extensive experience extracting, transforming, and loading data across cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

Familiarity with bypassing advanced anti-bot protections, IP rotation systems, and browser fingerprinting challenges.

Practical experience deploying serverless microservices (AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Workers) for distributed web crawling tasks.
