title: Senior Principal - Platform Engineer Network Capabilities
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.
* Extensive experience engineering shared network services such as Domain Name System, Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol and Internet Protocol address management.
* Strong knowledge of network access control, application programming interfaces, automation, monitoring and resilient service design.
* Evidence of improving service reliability, self service, deployment speed or operational efficiency.

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

AI Programming, Automation, Automation Technology, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Data Distribution Service (DDS), Data Management and Integration (DMI), IP Address Management (IPAM), Leadership, Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Security Management, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Universal Description Discovery and Integration (UDDI), Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

title: Principal I, Cloud & Middleware Architecture (Platform Engineering)
description:
**Summary of Position:**

  

We are seeking a **Principal Platform Engineer** to help lead the design, engineering, automation, and operation of enterprise cloud and Kubernetes platforms supporting cloud, datacenter, manufacturing, and edge environments.

The selected candidate will serve as a senior technical leader responsible for transforming architecture strategy into secure, scalable, automated, and supportable platform capabilities. The role combines deep hands-on engineering expertise with technical leadership and close collaboration across architecture, security, infrastructure, operations, and application teams.

The successful candidate will help drive modernization initiatives through cloud-native technologies, platform engineering practices, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps, GitOps, and automation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Platform Engineering**
------------------------

* Design, build, and operate enterprise cloud and Kubernetes platform capabilities across AWS, Azure, hybrid, on-premises, and edge environments.
* Translate architectural standards into reusable engineering patterns, automation, platform services, and operational capabilities.
* Lead technical design and implementation activities for strategic platform initiatives.

  + Cluster lifecycle management
  + Worker node design and scaling
  + Networking and ingress
  + Storage integration

  + Platform observability
  + Backup and recovery
  + Security controls and policy enforcement

  + Production Edge environments
  + MES/SCADA-supporting platforms
  + GPU-enabled workloads

**Infrastructure as Code & Automation**

* Develop reusable infrastructure modules and deployment frameworks using Terraform and approved automation technologies.
* Implement GitOps deployment patterns using Argo CD, or approved alternatives.
* Drive automation-first approaches for provisioning, configuration management, upgrades, compliance validation, and operational support.
* Build repeatable deployment patterns that reduce operational effort while improving consistency and quality.

**DevSecOps & Platform Reliability**
------------------------------------

* Integrate security, compliance, and operational controls into platform delivery processes.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure, platform services, and Kubernetes lifecycle activities.
* Support vulnerability management, policy enforcement, secrets management, and certificate management capabilities.
* Define and improve platform reliability, availability, observability, backup, and recovery capabilities.

**Qualification, Testing & Continuous Improvement**
---------------------------------------------------

* Develop automated validation and qualification frameworks for:
  + Kubernetes releases
  + Infrastructure profiles
  + Storage integrations
  + Network integrations
  + Security controls
  + Platform services
  + Edge deployments
  + GPU-enabled configurations
* Contribute to platform certification and supportability programs.
* Support development of platform standards, support matrices, and operational runbooks.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, standardization, measurement, and operational feedback.

**Collaboration & Technical Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Partner with architects, security teams, infrastructure teams, operations teams, and application teams to deliver platform capabilities.
* Participate in architecture reviews and technology evaluations.
* Help define engineering roadmaps and implementation plans.
* Contribute to platform strategy through practical implementation experience and operational insights.

**Key** **Responsibilities/Minimum** **Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree with 5+ years of total experience.

* Experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Infrastructure Engineering, or related technical disciplines.
* Strong knowledge of AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Hands-on experience with **Kubernetes platforms** such as Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), OpenShift, RKE2, or equivalent enterprise Kubernetes platforms
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred), CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, Linux administration, Containers and container platforms, Cloud networking and security, Observability and monitoring solutions
* Experience implementing highly available, secure, and scalable platform solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with AWS Control Tower, Landing Zones, Account Governance, and Cloud Security services.
* Experience with Argo CD, Helm, and modern Kubernetes platform tooling.
* Experience with JFrog Artifactory or enterprise artifact management solutions.
* Experience with Security Hub, CloudTrail, CloudFront, Audit Manager, Azure security services, and related governance tooling.
* Experience in manufacturing, edge computing, industrial, or distributed platform environments.
* Experience supporting disconnected or intermittently connected environments.
* Experience with GPU-enabled infrastructure and AI/ML platforms.
* Experience with platform qualification, testing, and release certification practices.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, JavaScript, or similar technologies.
* Relevant cloud, DevOps, Terraform, Kubernetes, or security certifications.

**Measures of Success:**

Success in this role will be demonstrated by:

* Delivery of secure, reliable, and reusable platform capabilities.
* Successful implementation of cloud and Kubernetes platform services aligned to roadmap objectives.
* Increased automation and reduction of manual operational effort.
* Improved platform reliability, security, scalability, and supportability.

* Effective qualification, testing, and lifecycle management of platform technologies.

title: MS Teams with Enterprise Voice Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**  
As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation.
  
  
At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities. The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.
  
  
**What you will do**

As a Microsoft Teams Administrator with Enterprise Voice skills, you will:

* Design, configure, and manage Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice solutions, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Deploy and integrate Session Border Controllers (SBCs) with Microsoft Teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve voice-related issues in Microsoft Teams, including call quality, routing, and interoperability with PSTN providers.
* Manage and support Microsoft Teams policies, configurations, and voice-enabled features.
* Collaborate with network and security teams to ensure compliance and optimal performance.
* Perform migrations from legacy PBX systems to Microsoft Teams.
* Work with external vendors and telecom providers to ensure seamless voice connectivity.
* Monitor Teams Voice infrastructure using analytics and reporting tools to optimize call performance.
Provide end-user support and training on Microsoft Teams Phone features.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in Microsoft Teams Voice and Telephony Solutions.
* Experience in PBX to Microsoft Teams migrations.
* Knowledge of Power Automate and Power Apps for workflow automation in Teams.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Strong understanding of SIP, VoIP, PSTN connectivity, and SBC configurations (AudioCodes, Ribbon, etc.).
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), PowerShell scripting, and Teams Admin Center.
Knowledge of E911 compliance, call routing policies, dial plans, and number management  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Teams Administrator Associate (MS-700).
* Microsoft Certified: Teams Voice Engineer (MS-721).
Session Border Controller (SBC) certifications (AudioCodes/Ribbon).  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Product Development Engineer (Career Rotation Program)
description:
**Your Job**

**Engineering Rotational Program**

Phillips Medisize, a Molex Company is seeking a dynamic, curious engineer to join our Engineering Rotational Program, a dynamic opportunity to develop solutions in medical devices that improve patient lives. As a part of the global rotational program, you'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to work on platform medical devices to help design and solve some of the challenging global problems.

The Engineering Rotational Program is designed for aspiring engineers to gain experience in various areas of engineering and determine an area to further develop in their career. The Rotational Program involves 6-month rotations across Phillips Medisize / Molex locations within Asia.

**What We Offer**

The Engineering Rotational Program is designed to develop the next generation of technical and business leaders. You will be given technical leadership opportunities and skills training, rotational work assignments, team interface and interaction and exposure to Senior and Executive Management. Engineers complete rotational assignments within a variety of focused areas in their engineering discipline over a 18-month period. This opportunity is created to provide challenging and enriching work assignments, an opportunity to gain familiarity with global systems and practices across the organization, and a chance to explore individual interests.

**You Will Gain**

* Hands on technical and leadership development
* Exposure and work assignments across various engineering groups over the two-year program, based on your skills and business needs
* Opportunities to collaborate with senior leaders and executive management
* Challenging assignments that build familiarity with Molex Systems' practices across the organization
* The opportunity to explore individual interest aligned with company objectives

**What You Will Do**

* Comprehensive understanding of the organization's engineering operations to collaborate for new business.
* Product design transfer to manufacturing facilities within global R & D sites.
* Technical support for design transfer and setting up manufacturing capabilities.
* Facilitate knowledge transfer, and helps build strong professional network.
* Share application knowledge and product development activities to the global team.
* Develop a well-rounded engineer with a deep understanding of the organization's operations.
* Contribute innovative ideas and state of the art thinking to improve business performance
* Participate in programs, projects, and initiatives aligned with company's culture and strategy
* Participate in design verification activities and to help ensure that design / process meets the needs of the customer.
* Provide technical support to engineering teams as well as manufacturing and quality as needed. This may include but not limited to design work, testing, document management, etc.
* Rotate through multiple technical disciplines to broaden skills and experience

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical / industrial engineering or equivalent with a minimum of 2 years' experience
* Prior experience in a product development or manufacturing organization
* Experience presenting technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

title: Principal - IAM Advanced Authentication
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centered on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**:

The Principal Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for designing, building, automating and improving GSK’s enterprise certificate services. Reporting to the Lead, PKI, the role translates approved architecture, security standards and service priorities into secure, resilient production capabilities; makes day-to-day engineering decisions within those guardrails; and serves as a technical escalation point for complex PKI issues.

**About the team**:

The PKI team provides trusted machine, device, user and application identities across GSK. The team engineers and operates enterprise certificate authorities and certificate lifecycle services, enables automated certificate issuance and renewal, and supports secure communications across on-premises, cloud and operational technology environments. It works with security architecture, platform operations, application teams and service partners to maintain clear ownership from solution design through production support.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to deliver key engineering activities and deepen your technical expertise. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Design, build, configure and maintain enterprise certificate authority and registration authority services.
* Engineer secure certificate issuance, renewal, revocation and recovery processes for users, devices, applications and workloads.
* Automate certificate discovery, inventory, issuance, renewal, revocation and reporting using APIs, scripting, infrastructure as code and enterprise certificate lifecycle management platforms.
* Integrate PKI with Microsoft and Linux platforms, network and security devices, cloud services, DevOps pipelines, applications, mobile and endpoint management platforms, and operational technology environments.
* Implement certificate profiles, templates and policy controls in line with approved architecture, Certificate Policy and Certification Practice Statement requirements, security standards and cryptographic requirements.
* Monitor service health, capacity, availability, certificate expiry, issuance quality and control effectiveness; define actionable alerting and operational thresholds; and remediate vulnerabilities, performance constraints or configuration drift.
* Troubleshoot complex certificate, trust-chain, revocation, protocol and interoperability issues and provide technical leadership during incidents.
* Plan and execute upgrades, migrations, key ceremonies, backup and restoration validation, disaster recovery tests and service improvements with appropriate change, security and evidence controls.
* Produce and maintain engineering designs, build documentation, runbooks, test evidence and integration guidance.
* Partner with the PKI Lead, operations, architecture, security, audit, application teams and service partners; mentor engineers; review technical designs and changes; and communicate engineering risks, dependencies and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* At least five years of hands-on experience engineering and supporting enterprise PKI or certificate lifecycle services, including responsibility for production design, implementation, troubleshooting and continuous improvement.
* Strong knowledge of X.509 certificates, certificate chains and path validation, enrollment, revocation, OCSP, CRLs, key management, cryptographic algorithms and core PKI security principles.
* Practical experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services or a comparable enterprise certificate authority platform.
* Experience integrating certificates with Windows, Linux, network devices, applications or cloud services, including relevant dependencies on Active Directory, DNS, privileged access and service identities.
* Ability to automate technical processes using PowerShell, Python, APIs or infrastructure-as-code tooling.
* Experience diagnosing complex production issues and implementing sustainable corrective actions.
* Strong documentation, collaboration and communication skills in a global engineering environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience with certificate lifecycle management platforms and automated enrollment protocols such as SCEP, EST or ACME.
* Experience with hardware security modules, protected key operations and formal key ceremonies.
* Knowledge of cloud-native certificate services and workload identity patterns in Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* Experience supporting device, network, operational technology or code-signing certificate use cases.
* Familiarity with cryptographic standards, audit controls and regulated-industry requirements.

* Relevant certification in Microsoft, cloud, security or PKI technologies.
* Typical tools and technologies: Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services, enterprise certificate lifecycle management platforms, hardware security modules, Azure Key Vault, X.509, TLS, SCEP, EST, ACME, OCSP, CRLs, PowerShell, Python, REST APIs and infrastructure as code.

**Skills**

Account Lifecycle Management, Authentication Systems, Automation Technology, Certificate Management, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Cryptography, Database Management, Directory Services, Enterprise Systems Engineering, Identity Access Management (IAM), Identity Lifecycle Management, Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Infrastructure Security, Key Management, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Security Controls, Service Integration, System Monitors, Systems Troubleshooting, Troubleshooting

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. title: Google Cloud Expert

**Preferred Professional Experience:**
======================================

Experience in disaster recovery, high availability, and enterprise cloud modernization initiatives.

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

We’re here to champion your journey. title: Platform Engineer I

AI Engineering & Intelligent Operations

* Use AI-assisted software development tools to improve engineering productivity.
* Develop AI-powered incident summarisation and communication capabilities.
* Build intelligent root cause analysis and diagnostic tooling.
* Create operational copilots and engineering assistants.
* Enhance alerts with contextual intelligence.
* Automate diagnostics and operational workflows.
* Build AI-driven orchestration and auto-remediation capabilities.
* Develop engineering knowledge systems that improve troubleshooting and accelerate learning.

* Cloud Infrastructure (AWS)
* Kubernetes
* CI/CD Engineering
* Infrastructure as Code
* Observability & Monitoring
* Major Incident Management
* Production Operations
* Reliability Engineering (SRE)
* Automation Engineering

title: Operational Reporting Lead
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**About the role**

The Operational Reporting Lead role is responsible for leading development, delivery and continuous improvement of operational, service performance, commercial and financial reporting for the Supplier and Commercial Management function within the CTO Infrastructure Organisation.

  

The role will provide accurate, timely and insightful reporting to support operational management, service delivery, technology leadership and strategic decision-making. It will establish a consistent, data-driven view of infrastructure performance, ensuring that Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), service risks, contractual commitments, supplier performance and financial outcomes are effectively measured, monitored and reported.

  

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical and technical capabilities with a comprehensive understanding of infrastructure technologies, operational service management, commercial contracts and financial processes. They will be responsible for transforming complex operational and financial data into meaningful management information, actionable insights and interactive dashboards, enabling stakeholders to identify trends, address service issues, manage risks and drive continuous improvement.

  

**Key responsibilities**

* Own and lead the end-to-end operational reporting capability for Supplier and Commercial Management function within the CTO Organisation.
* Design, develop and maintain a comprehensive suite of operational reports, management information packs, scorecards and executive dashboards.
* Accountable for ensuring consistent reporting across internal teams and external vendors.
* Ensure reporting is accurate, timely, repeatable, auditable and aligned with business and technology objectives.
* Translate complex technical and operational data into concise, meaningful insights for technical teams, senior management and executive stakeholders.
* Develop reporting calendars, ownership models, controls and quality assurance processes to ensure consistent delivery.
* Own the reporting and analysis of SLAs, KPIs, operational level agreements (OLAs), service performance targets and contractual service commitments.
* Define, document and maintain meaningful performance measures, including calculation methodologies, reporting frequency, data sources, thresholds and ownership.
* Work with service owners, technical teams and suppliers to validate performance data and ensure reported results accurately reflect service delivery.
* Lead the design, development, implementation and ongoing maintenance of interactive Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions, which leverages data stored in a data lake to deliver actional business insights and support data driven decision making.
* Build intuitive, visually effective dashboards that provide operational, technical, commercial and financial insights to different stakeholder groups.
* Integrate and consolidate data from multiple sources, including infrastructure monitoring tools, IT service management platforms, CMDBs, spreadsheets, databases, supplier reports and financial systems.
* Continuously improve dashboard design and reporting functionality based on stakeholder feedback and changing business requirements.
* Demonstrate expert-level Microsoft Excel capability and act as a subject matter expert for complex reporting and analytical requirements.
* Develop and maintain sophisticated reporting models, analytical workbooks, reconciliations and management information tools.
* Automate recurring reporting activities and reduce reliance on manual spreadsheet manipulation.
* Apply a strong understanding of infrastructure technologies to interpret operational data accurately and ensure reporting reflects the underlying technical environment.
* Work closely with infrastructure architects, engineers, service owners, operations teams and technology suppliers to understand service performance and technical dependencies.
* Understand how infrastructure components contribute to end-to-end service delivery, availability, resilience and operational risk.
* Challenge anomalies, validate reported data with technical subject matter experts and investigate unexpected performance movements.
* Work closely with Finance, Technology Finance, Procurement, Commercial Management and budget owners to support financial planning, reporting and cost control across infrastructure.
* Establish and maintain appropriate data quality standards, controls and reporting governance across operational, commercial and financial datasets.
* Define authoritative data sources, data owners, calculation methodologies and reconciliation requirements.
* Investigate and resolve data quality issues, inconsistencies and discrepancies with the relevant source system owners.
* Implement validation checks, exception reporting and quality assurance procedures.
Present complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.  

  

**Qualifications and skills**

* Bachelors Degree.
* Minimum 12+ years' experience working within a technology infrastructure environment.
* Knowledge of ITIL practices, particularly incident, problem, change, service level and continual improvement management.
* Expert-level Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, data manipulation, reconciliation and automation.
* Experience integrating Power BI with SQL databases, APIs, SharePoint, Excel and enterprise reporting platforms.
* Experience with cloud cost management, FinOps, infrastructure consumption reporting or technology cost optimisation.
* Proven experience leading reporting activities across complex infrastructure operations, ideally within a large enterprise or multi-supplier environment.
* Proven experience in operational reporting, performance management, service management or business intelligence within a technology or infrastructure environment.
* Experience producing reporting for senior technology leadership and operational governance forums.
* Demonstrable experience designing, building and maintaining dashboards from requirements gathering through to deployment and ongoing support.
* Strong understanding of ITIL and IT infrastructure technologies and how infrastructure services operate, including compute, storage, networks, cloud, backup, resilience and monitoring.
* Strong experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent tools.
* Experience working with infrastructure monitoring and observability platforms.
* Experience working with and leveraging Data Lakes to develop insightful Power BI dashboards and support data-driven decision-making.
* Strong practical Power BI expertise, including dashboard development, data modelling, Power Query, DAX, data visualisation and automated reporting.
* Experience integrating Power BI with SQL databases, APIs, SharePoint, Excel, PowerApp and enterprise reporting platforms.
* Experience with cloud cost management, FinOps, infrastructure consumption reporting or technology cost optimisation.
* Familiarity with IT asset management, CMDBs, configuration data and service mapping.
* Extensive experience measuring and reporting SLAs, KPIs, service performance measures and operational metrics.
* Experience analysing service performance, identifying trends and investigating exceptions.
Strong commercial awareness and experience reporting on supplier performance, contracts, service commitments and expenditure.  

  

**Job Posting End Date**

2026-11-11  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Consulting Engineer
description:

Additionally, the role creates customer-facing documentation aligned with CX standards, leverages AI and automation to enhance delivery efficiency and innovation and increases personal productivity by focusing on high-impact work. The position also involves developing vertical market expertise to translate customer business needs into technical solutions, building knowledge of vendor and competitor products to ensure interoperability and optimization, and contributing to knowledge sharing and the development of digital intellectual capital, including documentation templates and automation artifacts to improve Cisco's delivery methodology and processes.

* Creates and reviews project deliverables aligned to CX standards; contributes to new implementation techniques and methodologies
* Creates customer-facing documentation for complex solutions, ensuring technical accuracy; collaborates with internal teams to deliver and maintain content
* Provides insights on product and software vulnerabilities, advising customers on product issues and builds complex lab set-ups to resolve diverse
* Demonstrates expertise across a range of technologies and delivery methods (both Cisco and other vendors as needed for migration and integration)
* Leverages working knowledge of software programmability, automation, orchestration, virtualization, Agile and DevOps to optimize project outcomes
* Explains complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and transfers knowledge to customers to ensure effective use of products and solutions

* Proactively analyzes and scans the competitive landscape to identify potential opportunities for innovation and AI transformation
* Effectively integrates AI into daily workflows to automate recurring tasks (e.g., data collection, formatting), validates and refines AI outputs to ensure quality
* Acts as a trusted advisor, helping customer to understand decisions and recommendations, communicating technical issues, negotiating schedule changes and shifting outcomes with clients
* Expands collaboration across Cisco, vendors and partners to deliver a consistent and unified approach
* Supports and collaborates with TAC/other stakeholders on CAP case resolution
* Typically interacts with Sales team, individual contributors, managers, and customers

**Minimum Qualifications:**  
Bachelors + 5 years of related experience, or
  
Masters + 3 years of related experience, or
  
PhD + 0 years of related experience, or
  
equivalent relevant work experience
  
Professional level (e.g., CCNP) or equivalent relevant certification expected
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

title: Senior Solution Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Every minute of every day, Smiths Detection’s threat detection and security screening technology helps to protect people and infrastructure, making the world a safer place.

Smiths Detection is a global leader in the development, manufacture and management of security and detection solutions designed to make the world a safer place. Our technology provides threat detection and screening solutions for customers in our key markets: aviation, ports and borders, defence, and urban security.

Our expertise spans 21 global offices, seven manufacturing sites and five R&D centres, with a global network of 3,500 dedicated colleagues contributing towards over 40 years at the frontline of advances in safety and security.

This results in careers built on variety and the opportunity to work on a range of state-of-the-art solutions, where you can develop your knowledge and experience every day.

 **Job Description**

**Job Purpose:**

Design, evaluate and govern SAP-centric business solutions that support Smiths Detection's business strategy, enterprise architecture standards and cyber security requirements. The role will act as the technical authority for SAP solution design, integration, data flows and business process optimisation across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, HR and other enterprise functions.

**Duties:**

* Lead solution design activities for SAP and associated enterprise applications.
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure and supportable solution architectures.
* Define and maintain solution architectures, integrations, interfaces and end-to-end business process designs.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, project teams, cyber security, infrastructure and application vendors.
* Review solution designs for compliance with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements and integration principles.
* Support ERP transformation, application rationalisation and enterprise modernisation initiatives.
* Produce architecture artefacts, including solution diagrams, interface specifications, data flow maps and technical documentation.
* Evaluate third-party applications and integrations with SAP and enterprise platforms.
* Support Architecture Review Board activities and technology governance processes.
* Assist with application roadmap development and lifecycle management.

  
**Qualifications**

**Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
* 8+ years of experience in SAP solution design, enterprise applications or solution architecture.
* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC and SAP ecosystem technologies.
* Experience with SAP integrations, APIs, middleware and data migration approaches.
* Knowledge of enterprise integration platforms such as MuleSoft or equivalent.
* Understanding of cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
* Strong knowledge of architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.
* Experience working with cyber security, identity, governance and compliance requirements.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.

**Planning and Decision Making:**

* Proficient in independently planning and executing work within established deadlines
* Adheres rigorously to all relevant practices and documentation standards
* Conducts thorough reviews of own work to ensure attainment of desired outcomes

**Key Internal and External Relationships:**

* Enterprise Architecture
* Cyber Security
* Infrastructure & Cloud
* Digital & Data
* SAP Functional Leads
* Business Process Owners
* Third-Party Systems Integrators and SAP Partners

  
**Additional Information**

Join us and we’ll help build your career, with excellent training and opportunities for career growth across the business, both locally and globally. You’ll experience an inclusive environment, with strong leadership and a focus on safety and wellbeing. You’ll also have the flexibility to choose from a wide range of benefits to suit your lifestyle, offering you and your family support from a health and wellbeing, financial and lifestyle perspective.

**Join us and work for a world-leader, with the benefits and training to reward your dedication and skills. Be part of a team where we are making the world a safer place.**

We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity.

At no time during the hiring process will Smiths Detection, nor any of our recruitment partners ever request payment to enable participation – including, but not limited to, interviews or testing. Avoid fraudulent requests by applying jobs directly through our career’s website.

title: Software Design Engineer - LabVIEW
description:
**Role Summary:**

This position is responsible for software development of new products, with emphasis on user interfaces and device communication for wired and wireless industrial communication networks. The role also develops modular, scalable LabVIEW applications and integrates software with industrial hardware and test systems.

**Principle accountabilities:**

1. Design and code modular, scalable LabVIEW applications using Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), state machines, and producer-consumer architectures.

2. Interface LabVIEW software with NI DAQ devices, PLCs, HMIs, vision systems, electronic testers, and laboratory instruments.

3. Implement industrial communication protocols, including Modbus, HART, Foundation Fieldbus, PROFIBUS, OPC, FDT 1.2, FDT 2.0, and FDI, as applicable.

4. Develop automated test equipment (ATE), functional end-of-line test benches, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems.

5. Develop, test, and debug software code using contemporary tools and techniques.

6. Support the preparation of design documents, artifacts, and work products.

7. Work across all phases of the software development lifecycle.

8. Work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating with senior-level engineers who provide guidance on assigned tasks.

9. Continually update technical knowledge and skills.

**Educational Qualification & Experience:**

1. Bachelor’s degree **in electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Instrumentation Technology.**

2. Experience in software development for the Industrial Automation domain preferred; experience with FDT 1.2, FDT 2.0, OPC, and FDI is an advantage.

3. Experience in device description (EDDL) and device type manager (DTM) development.

4. Experience with LabVIEW application development and industrial test/measurement systems is preferred.

**Competencies and Skills:**

1. Knowledge of programming languages and technologies: C++, VC++, C#, JavaScript, SQL, XML, and EDDL.

2. Knowledge of **industrial communication protocols**, including HART, Foundation Fieldbus, PROFIBUS, Modbus, and OPC.

3. Knowledge of software concepts and frameworks: OOP, COM (MFC/ATL), and .NET (WPF/WCF).

4. Familiarity with software tools such as TFS, Subversion, MS SQL, and SQL Server.

5. Knowledge of LabVIEW is preferred.

6. Knowledge of distributed control systems and/or programmable logic controllers is an advantage.

7. Knowledge of microprocessor architecture, peripherals, and related analog/digital circuitry is an advantage.

8. Fast learner, able to work independently within a team.

9. Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks and respect deadlines.

10. Customer-focused with good analytical and problem-solving skills.

11. Excellent oral and written communication skills.

title: IT Engineer,Software,Advanced
description:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities:

* Lead systems design and development for open-source enterprise engineering applications used by R&D teams worldwide.
* Understand and document requirements, design solutions, write code, perform unit testing, and resolve technical issues.
* Provide deep-level support for production applications, using strong diagnostics and root cause analysis.
* Become the subject matter expert for these applications, applying usability and development best practices.
* Partner with business, design, and development team members, and with IT service providers, to deliver high-quality IT services and customer satisfaction.
* Develop and maintain database components that support part and CAD data processing and distribution.
* Use approved AI tools to accelerate coding, code review, unit test creation, troubleshooting, and documentation. Validate all AI-generated output before use.

* 3+ years of Perl development experience.

*Preferred*

* Database development experience.
* Hands-on experience using generative AI or LLM-based assistants for software development, such as code generation, refactoring, test creation, and documentation.
* Experience applying AI to legacy code understanding or modernization.
* Experience integrating AI-enabled workflows or APIs into engineering applications.
* Interest in or exposure to big data technologies.

Careers Privacy Statement\*\*\*Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.\*\*\*

title: Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under guidance. Applies basic scalability requirements, conducts performance/load testing, and configures resiliency features (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts) to handle network variability. Builds telemetry, alerts, and runbook-driven procedures; delivers scoped features and fault-injection tests; and helps implement basic data replication and synchronization. Assists with on-call rotations, uses automation/IaC scripts to troubleshoot, and follows change, security, and compliance procedures (encryption, access controls, remediation plans) while escalating complex issues to senior engineers.

  

**Key Responsibilities**  
**System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:**  
–Assist in the implementation of components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling under the guidance of senior engineers.
  
–Optimize code segments and/or systems for large-scale data processing with oversight from senior engineers.
  
–Implement scalability requirements for assigned components.
  
–Learn about the use of data plane platforms for large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
–Execute performance and load testing, with guidance.
  
**System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:**  
–Collaborate with the team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by learning about redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
–Learn about recovery oriented computing principles and assist in applying them to component designs.
  
–Configure and test retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability, with guidance
  
**System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:**  
–Implement testing and alarming configurations to detect issues/failures.
  
–Support efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures, under guidance.
  
–Help build dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.
  
**System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:**  
–Implement functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
  
–Implement test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness, under guidance.
  
–Help implement basic data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
**Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:**  
–Assist in diagnosing and debugging issues in system components to support ongoing operation, under supervision.
  
–Follow protocols to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
–Run basic automation scripts and tooling to troubleshoot operational issues.
  
–Participate in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.
  
**Compliance & Security:**  
–Assist in implementing basic security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.
  
–Assist in the execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, under supervision.
  
–Support the creation and updating of documentation to ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations.
  
**Automation & Change Management:**  
–Assist in maintaining basic automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)).
  
–Adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, under guidance

**Core Responsibilities**  
**Planning & Execution:**  
–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.
  
–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance
  
**Collaboration & Partnership:**  
–Collaborate within the team to better understand expectations and achieve shared objectives.
  
–Leverage a foundational understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build partnerships with limited guidance.
  
–Actively listen and ask questions to enhance collaboration.
  
–Build a basic understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs with guidance.
  
**Problem Solving:**  
–Identify and address issues, escalating problems to senior staff as needed in accordance with standard procedures.
  
–Compile and review data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors.
  
**Continuous Learning:**  
–Seek opportunities to gain knowledge and learn new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices.
  
–Utilize feedback and training to improve skills.
  
–Participate in a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.
  
**Continuous Improvement:**  
–Implement updates to processes, protocols, and workflows to increase efficiency and effectiveness as directed, with some guidance.
  
–Contribute to ideation for future process improvements.

title: Senior Principal - RTE
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Release Train Engineer is a servant leader and delivery coach for the Agile Release Train delivering GSK's network and connectivity platforms, applying SAFe practices within GSK's Technology operating model to coordinate the flow of value across the teams building and running those platforms. Operating consistently with the BCG platform operating model, the role treats the platform as a product delivered by a durable, cross-functional team, and is accountable for facilitating Programme Increment planning, coordinating dependencies and risks across teams, and driving predictable, high quality delivery through Agile ceremonies, flow metrics and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Facilitate Programme Increment planning and Agile Release Train execution**

* Plan, prepare and facilitate PI Planning, System Demos, Inspect and Adapt workshops and other Agile Release Train events for the platform's teams.
* Coordinate Scrum of Scrums, ART sync and cross-team ceremonies to maintain alignment on scope, sequencing and delivery against the Programme Increment.
* Build and maintain the ART's Programme Board, tracking major milestones, cross-team dependencies and feature delivery against the Programme Increment.
* Support Product Management and Product Owners in refining the Programme Backlog and preparing content for Planning Interval events.

**Manage dependencies, risks and impediments across the train**

* Identify, track and resolve cross-team and cross-platform dependencies and risks using ROAM (Resolved, Owned, Accepted, Mitigated).
* Escalate and remove impediments to flow that individual teams cannot resolve themselves, including supplier, platform or portfolio level blockers.
* Coordinate with other Release Train Engineers, Solution Train Engineers and Platform Managers to sequence work across dependent platforms and domains.

**Drive flow, predictability and continuous improvement**

* Track and report flow metrics including velocity, programme predictability, cycle time and quality trends, and use them to drive improvement actions.

title: threat detection engineer
description:
**what is CRED?**

CRED is an exclusive community for India’s most trustworthy and CREDitworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true

here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better

### **what you will do ?**

* work across a diverse information security domain, with a strong focus on threat detection, response, and security telemetry across infrastructure, cloud, and data
* identify and investigate security threats (internal and external), partner with stakeholders on remediation, and design preventive controls for recurring or systemic issues
* design, build, and continuously improve high-fidelity detection use cases across cloud, endpoint, identity, and network telemetry
* formulate new detection ideas based on adversary research, emerging attack techniques, industry incidents, and threat intelligence
* lead and participate in incident response, performing root-cause analysis and driving preventive improvements post-incident
* develop and enhance the CRED’s detection, monitoring and response capabilities
* automate incident response workflows using playbooks and orchestration to reduce manual effort
* build in-house security analytics solutions using open source tools (log parsing, event correlation and threat detection)research/conduct threat hunting operations using known adversary tactics, techniques and procedures to detect advanced threats
* assist with creating security awareness and maintaining prudent security engineering culture within an organization
* enable compliance in teams and help them achieve some of the industry’s best practices (e.g. PCI DSS, ISO 27001)

### **you should apply if you have:**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in information security with a strong focus on threat detection and response
* hands-on experience detecting and responding to threats across cloud (aws preferred), endpoint (windows/linux/macOS), and network telemetry
* exposure to EDR, IDS/IPS, and SIEM / centralized logging platforms (splunk, ELK, sentinel, or similar), including building high-fidelity detection pipelines
* proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (python, go, or bash)
* solid understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, cyber kill chain, and diamond model
* ability to design and tune detection rules using MITRE ATT&CK and threat intelligence with a focus on signal quality
* experience with threat hunting, automation and enrichment, regex creation, and false-positive reduction
* experience handling the complete incident response lifecycle, from detection through remediation and reporting
* strong data-driven mindset with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* ability to act as a go-to person, communicating clearly with engineering, product, and business teams
* proactive approach to staying current with security news, breach reports, tools, and attacker research
* strong learning agility and passion for exploring diverse security domains, demonstrated via github, blogs, research, or talks
* exposure to the AI-driven threat landscape, digital forensics, or malware analysis is a strong plus

**how is life at CRED?**

working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you. not just in the role you occupy, but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, standup comic, artist, writer, an athlete, maybe a magician. at CRED people always have talent up their sleeves. with the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company.

hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role. and we realize pushing oneself is hard work. which is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate oneself: included but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves and a comprehensive health insurance.

to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things, CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word.

since trust is a major virtue in the community we have built, we make it a point to highlight it in the community behind CRED: all our employees get their salaries before their joining date. a show of trust that speaks volumes because of the skin in the game.

there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch.

title: Director - SN ITOM, ITAM & ITSM Platform Manager
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The ServiceNow ITOM, ITAM & ITSM Product Manager leads a group of related Products within a ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools Domain, ensuring they deliver measurable value, support business processes, and are continuously improved. They work closely with the SD, SERVICENOW Platform & Enterprise Tools to translate functional goals into product roadmaps and provide direction to Product Owners on prioritisation, delivery focus, and product performance. The ServiceNow ITOM (Event/Discovery/CMDB), ITAM (SAM/HAM) & ITSM Product Manager ensures Products are usable, compliant, secure, and efficient to operate, while fostering a culture of agile delivery, value realisation, and continuous improvement across ServiceNow Platform and Enterprise Tools.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Translate functional strategies provided by the Senior Director, SERVICENOW Platform & Enterprise Tools into actionable product roadmaps and delivery priorities across a related group of Products - ITOM (Event/Discovery/CMDB), ITAM (SAM/HAM) & ITSM,
* Provide direction and coaching to Product Owners, ensuring requirements are well-defined, business cases for investment are robust, backlogs are prioritised to support business goals, architectural guidance, compliance needs, data-drivendecisions, FinOps considerations, and domain ecosystem dependencies through cross-functional partnering.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand pain points, process challenges, and improvement needs, shaping product enhancements and technology-enabled opportunities.
* Oversee delivery execution across the product group, ensuring the quality, usability, stability, and supportability of released features and services.
* Promote agile and iterative delivery practices (e.g. SaFe, Scrum), supporting incremental value release, transparency of priorities, and improved collaboration with business users.
* Act as the escalation point for critical product performance, delivery issues, and dependency conflicts, addressing risks and facilitating decisions.
* Champion the adoption of user-centred improvements, business process optimisation, and automation opportunities that reduce cycle time and enhance user experience.
* Ensure effective risk, security, and compliance management (e.g. ISO controls) across the product group, embedding relevant controls in partnership with security and compliance SMEs.
* Support Solution Architects in shaping cross-product and cross-platform solutions, ensuring Product Owners manage dependencies to deliver integrated outcomes.
* Track and report performance against agreed KPIs for the product group, driving continuous improvement activities to maximise value for the Domain.
* Provide financial oversight of the domain, including product budgets and internal/external team resourcing costs, to inform strategic decision‑making and ensure alignment with GSK’s financial objectives.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM)

**Job Experience :**

  

* Extensive experience (typically 18+ years) overseeing end-to-end product delivery, including prioritisation, backlog management, solution design support, testing oversight, and value-focused release planning.
* Proven track record in overseeing the definition and execution of valuable Product strategies (such as ServiceNow), realising tangible benefits for the Business with experience in core products for digital and tech – ITOM, ITAM, CMDB, ITSM.
* Deep experience in concurrently overseeing multiple Product teams across the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements elicitation through to release.
* Proficient in conveying complex technology ideas to non-conversant audiences.
* Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills for developing Product use cases and determining their associated value.
* Highly experienced team leader that can effectively manage small to medium IT delivery teams).
* Very strong communication skills and ability to influence senior stakeholders, aligning on competing priorities and guiding Business teams on the feasibility of requests vs. technology constraints.

**Desirable Requirements**

  

* ServiceNow platform leadership across ITOM(Event/Discovery), ITAM (HAM/SAM), and ITSM – Proven ability to set vision and roadmap for a mature implementation, prioritising capabilities that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Hands-on understanding of core ServiceNow architecture and data model – Experience with CMDB, discovery/visibility, asset models, workflows, and integrations to effectively challenge and guide product managers and engineers.
* Cross-functional stakeholder management and change leadership\*\* – Able to translate complex platform capabilities into clear value propositions, align IT and business stakeholders, and drive adoption, process standardisation, and continuous improvement.

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to guide prioritisation decisions, resolve delivery conflicts, and align multiple stakeholders around shared product outcomes.
* Skilled in coaching and developing Product Owners, fostering a culture of user-centred design, value-based delivery, and continuous improvement.
* Able to interpret business processes, regulatory needs, and operational insights to identify optimisation and automation opportunities that enhance product performance and user experience.

description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Platform Architect owns the technical design of GSK's voice and unified communications platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations.

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
