* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.

* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.

* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.

title: Dist Engr-AI Science
description:
### **When you join Verizon**

We are seeking a visionary **Distinguished Engineer, AI Science** to lead the technical strategy, research, and development of our next-generation AI architecture focused on Customer Base Management (CVM). As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be the foremost technical authority in the organization, driving the evolution from traditional machine learning to advanced Agentic, Predictive, and Prescriptive AI systems.

You will design autonomous, AI-driven engines that maximize the lifetime value of our customer base, architecting systems that not only predict customer behavior but prescribe dynamic, real-time interventions and execute them autonomously via multi-agent frameworks.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Visionary Technical Leadership & AI Strategy**

* Serve as the chief technical architect and visionary for all AI science initiatives related to Base Management, Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), churn mitigation, and cross-sell/upsell monetization.
* Define the multi-year roadmap for integrating Agentic AI (autonomous agents, LLM-driven decision engines) into our core base management platforms.
* Bridge the gap between foundational AI research and enterprise-scale commercial impact, advising C-level executives on AI investments and technology bets.

**2. Advanced AI Modeling & Agentic Architecture**

* **Agentic AI:** Architect multi-agent systems and LLM-backed autonomous pipelines capable of executing complex customer lifecycle interventions without human-in-the-loop dependencies.
* **Predictive AI:** Oversee the development of state-of-the-art predictive models (deep learning, sequence modeling, probabilistic models) for extreme-accuracy forecasting of churn, propensity, and customer lifecycle events.
* **Prescriptive AI:** Design large-scale optimization and reinforcement learning (RL) engines that determine the "Next Best Action" (NBA), Next Best Offer (NBO), and dynamic pricing strategies in real-time.
* Pioneer the use of Generative AI for hyper-personalized base communication, ensuring safety, compliance, and brand alignment within agentic workflows.

**3. Base Management Innovation**

* Transform traditional Customer Value Management (CVM) into a continuous, real-time, AI-native discipline.
* Develop scalable algorithms for causal inference and uplift modeling to ensure AI interventions generate true incremental value (A/B testing at scale).
* Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations leaders to deploy AI solutions that fundamentally alter the economics of customer retention and growth.

**4. Mentorship & Eminence**

* Act as a technical mentor and sponsor for Principal Scientists, Senior Machine Learning Engineers, and Data Scientists across the organization.
* Drive a culture of engineering and scientific excellence, establishing rigorous standards for model validation, MLOps, AI safety, and ethical AI.
* Represent the company in the broader AI community through conference presentations, whitepapers, open-source contributions, and patent filings.

### **Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a closely related highly quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 12+ years of applied R&D experience in AI/ML, with at least 5+ years in a senior technical leadership role (Principal Engineer, Chief Scientist, or equivalent).
* **Domain Expertise:** Deep understanding of Base Management, Customer Value Management (CVM), algorithmic marketing, and lifecycle optimization.
* **Technical Mastery:**Expertise in **Predictive AI** (Deep Learning, NLP, Time-Series forecasting, Graph Neural Networks).Expertise in **Prescriptive AI** (Reinforcement Learning, Contextual Bandits, Mathematical Optimization, Operations Research).Cutting-edge knowledge of **Agentic AI** (LLMs, LangChain/LlamaIndex, multi-agent frameworks like AutoGen, tool-augmented language models).
* **Engineering Prowess:** Proven track record of architecting and deploying ultra-low latency, high-throughput AI systems into production. Fluency in Python, C++, or similar, and deep familiarity with scalable cloud architectures (AWS/GCP/Azure) and MLOps platforms.
* **Impact:** Demonstrable history of driving hundreds of millions of dollars in enterprise value through the application of AI to customer bases.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Recognized industry eminence (e.g., highly cited publications at NeurIPS, ICML, KDD, ACL, or strong portfolio of impactful patents).
* Experience transitioning legacy rule-based business logic systems into fully autonomous RL or Agentic AI decision engines.
* Deep expertise in Causal ML and Double Machine Learning for uplift modeling.

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

40

title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is expanding across existing and new regions. Our Networking organization builds systems that manage Internet and backbone traffic, mitigate congestion, and reduce customer impact while enabling network operations to scale efficiently.

The Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer mentors engineering teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. This role identifies and eliminates performance and scalability bottlenecks for hyperscale workloads, defines scalability requirements with stakeholders, and designs elastic, high-impact systems while driving innovation in data plane platforms.

We are seeking a Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer to define technical direction and lead the development of highly available, scalable network control, intelligent routing and automation systems. You will combine deep networking knowledge with software and distributed systems expertise to connect real-time observability with safe, automated routing decisions.

Your work will span autonomous traffic management, policy-driven network optimization, and software-based routing infrastructure. You will identify performance and scalability bottlenecks, define requirements with stakeholders, and design resilient services that protect customer connectivity during growth, failures, and infrastructure changes.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad architectural influence. Based in IDC alongside the engineering team, you will lead initiatives from design through production operations, contribute to critical implementations, and establish standards for availability, security, observability, and safe deployment. You will collaborate across engineering and operations teams while mentoring senior engineers and developing technical leadership.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define technical strategy and architecture for scalable routing, network control, and automation systems.
* Design algorithms and distributed services for route computation, congestion management, traffic steering, fault isolation, and recovery.
* Correlate network and infrastructure signals to assess customer impact and enable safe automated responses.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize capacity, resource utilization, routing convergence, and behavior under heavy load.
* Architect and build highly available, fault-tolerant systems with reliable state management, replication, automated failover, and recovery.
* Define service-level objectives, operational KPIs, telemetry, monitoring, and alerting for service health and routing outcomes.
* Establish simulation, scale testing, phased migrations, in-service upgrades, verification, and rollback practices.
* Lead production troubleshooting, incident response, and root-cause analysis; establish runbooks and drive reliability improvements.
* Integrate security controls, auditability, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment, patching, and lifecycle management.
* Contribute production-quality code, review designs and implementations, and maintain architecture and operational documentation.
* Partner with cross-functional engineering, product, and business stakeholders to define technical strategy and deliver high-impact initiatives.
* Mentor senior engineers, influence architectural direction, and promote engineering excellence through technical leadership, hiring, and knowledge sharing.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of relevant experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, network control planes, or network automation platforms.
* Strong Linux systems and networking knowledge, including containers, process and memory behavior, network namespaces, resource isolation, and packet-level troubleshooting.
* Experience designing highly available distributed services with reliable state management, observability, overload protection, and failure recovery.
* Demonstrated ability to lead architecture and delivery across teams, resolve ambiguous requirements, communicate technical trade-offs, and mentor senior engineers.
* Deep knowledge of L2/L3 networking, routing and switching, software-defined networking, traffic engineering, and WAN technologies.
* Strong expertise in BGP and MP-BGP, IPv4/IPv6, route reflection, routing policy, and VPN address families, including practical experience with convergence and reachability troubleshooting.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C++, with experience in API design, concurrency, automated testing, and production debugging.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Production expertise with Junos and Juniper cRPD or comparable virtualized routing platforms.
* Experience with BGP Add-Path, Optimal Route Reflection (ORR), Prefix Independent Convergence (BGP-PIC), route-flap damping, and large-scale routing tables.
* Knowledge of MPLS, RSVP-TE, PCEP, bandwidth reservation, latency-aware routing, and shared-risk link groups.
* Experience with NETCONF, Junos XML APIs, gRPC, OpenConfig, and model-driven network automation.
* Experience tuning containerized networking workloads, including cgroups, socket buffers, veth, and SR-IOV.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, automated lifecycle orchestration, and rolling upgrades for stateful services.
* Understanding of Clos fabrics, overlay/underlay integration, ECMP behavior, and backbone transit.
* Experience building distributed active measurement and telemetry systems.
* Experience with simulation, failure injection, or formal methods to validate complex distributed-system behavior.
* Experience applying traffic prediction, machine learning, or AI techniques to network optimization, anomaly detection, or operational intelligence.

title: Senior Principal - Automation / Prompt / Agent Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Automation Architect owns the technical design of a DPTF platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations. Platforms span cloud, network and digital workplace domains, and the specific platform is set on appointment.

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.

**Key Relationships/Customers**

Business Stakeholders

* Business stakeholders sponsoring platform capability with architectural consequence
* Quality and compliance functions where the platform supports GxP activity

Tech Stakeholders

  

* Platform Architecture Director as owner of domain target architecture
* Platform engineering teams applying the patterns and standards
* Product Owner and Platform Manager for roadmap and backlog consequence
* Enterprise Architecture and Solution Architects for enterprise alignment
* Information Security and Reliability Engineering for security and resilience standards

Others

  

* Managed service partners whose solution designs must meet platform architecture standards
* Technology vendors during evaluation and proof of concept

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform).

**Job Experience:**

  

* Typically 15 + years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace.
* Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard.
* Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context.
* Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet.
* Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations.

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Hands-on experience architecting and building AI/agentic systems — LLMs, evaluation pipelines, ML lifecycle — at production scale.
* Experience assessing data readiness (availability, quality, access, labeling) and flagging risks before builds start.
* Working knowledge of at least one pharma value chain area (R&D, manufacturing, or commercial).
* Background spotting reusable patterns across engagements and turning them into shared, durable technical capability.
* Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented.
* Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard.
* Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them.
* Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome.
* Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright.
* Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform

Agentic AI, Architecture Reviews, Asset Life Cycle Management, Data Integrity, Design Assurance, Digital Fluency, GxP Regulations, GxPs, Lean Management, Manufacturing Technologies, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Problem Solving, Risk Awareness, Standards Compliance, Technology Architecture

title: Principal Network Engineer
description:
Designs, implements, and operates resilient L3/L4 network services across data centers and cloud environments with broader influence beyond the immediate team. Leads moderately complex projects, drives automation and observability at scale, and contributes to standards and architectures. Mentors junior engineers, provides input on team decisions, and collaborates with SRE, platform, and security partners to deliver secure, compliant, and highly available network services with measurable impact on both team and group outcomes.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**L3/L4 Network Topologies and Overlays:**

* Lead designs for IP addressing, routing policies (BGP/OSPF/IS-IS), EVPN/VXLAN fabrics, and SDN overlays spanning on-prem and cloud.
* Define HA, ECMP, and traffic-engineering patterns; validate through lab/sandbox testing, failure modeling, and staged rollouts.
* Author design docs and drive reviews involving related teams; de-risk changes with method-of-procedure (MOP), rollback, and verification plans.

**Cloud Networking Implementation and Operations:**

* Implement and operate VPC/VNet topologies, subnets, routing tables, NAT, Transit/Hub-and-Spoke (e.g., TGW/VCN), PrivateLink/service endpoints, and inter-cloud connectivity.
* Design and tune L4/L7 load balancing and service insertion (proxies, firewalls) to meet defined SLOs and cost targets.
* Ensure consistent network policy and connectivity across environments using standard blueprints and golden configs.

**Network Security Controls and Compliance Guardrails:**

* Engineer segmentation (VRFs/security zones), ACLs/policies, encryption (IPsec/TLS), and DDoS/WAF integrations aligned to zero-trust.
* Embed compliance guardrails (change control, access least privilege, evidence collection) and partner with security/GRC to pass audits.
* Periodically review rulebases and routing policies; eliminate shadow/duplicate rules and reduce attack surface.

**Automation, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code:**

* Develop reusable Terraform modules and Ansible playbooks; enforce code reviews, linting, policy-as-code, and test gates in pipelines.
* Build validation and drift-detection tooling using APIs and scripting (e.g., Python); integrate automated rollbacks and canary changes.
* Champion GitOps practices, configuration data modeling, and inventory source of truth.

**Monitoring, Telemetry, and SLOs:**

* Implement SNMP/streaming telemetry, NetFlow/IPFIX, and flow logs for health, capacity, and security analytics.
* Define SLIs/SLOs (availability, latency, loss, jitter) and build dashboards/alerts/runbooks; lead capacity/perf reviews and right-sizing actions.
* Correlate telemetry with incidents; drive problem management and reduction of repeat issues.

**Cross-Team Collaboration and Operations Excellence:**

* Partner with SRE, platform, and security teams on architecture reviews, incident response, post-incident remediation, and capacity planning.
* Lead portions of on-call response and complex change events; coordinate with related teams to minimize risk and downtime.
* Contribute to cross-LOB standards, reference architectures, and service onboarding patterns.

**Documentation, Reviews, and Standards:**

* Produce and maintain high-quality design docs, network diagrams, runbooks, and inventories; ensure traceability to requirements and controls.
* Facilitate and participate in design/change reviews; capture decisions and lessons learned; evolve patterns and modules accordingly.
* Mentor junior engineers via code/document reviews, pairing, and knowledge shares.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**  

* Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**  

* Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

**Continuous Learning:**  

* Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**  

* Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**  
• Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About the team**

Sarvam builds Indic-language AI used at population scale. The CPU Infrastructure team runs everything outside the GPU fleet: Kubernetes across Azure, AWS, GCP and Indian sovereign clouds, the network between them, Cloudflare, identity, secrets, observability, cost and the delivery pipeline every product ships through.

The team builds and runs what it builds. Engineers own real systems end to end, and every repeated piece of manual work is a candidate for automation. As an AI company, we are building AI agents into our own operations, to plan and review infrastructure changes, triage alerts and handle routine issues, with engineers setting the guardrails.

**About the role**

You keep the infrastructure behind Sarvam’s products running. You handle day-to-day operations — deployments, provisioning, access, incidents and cost questions — and you are expected to automate that work away.

We hire for one instinct above everything else: you notice something done by hand every day, ask why it can’t run itself, and build the thing that removes it — a script, a pipeline step, a bot, a small Kubernetes operator, or an AI agent that does the work. Operations is a large part of this role, and it is where you find what is worth automating.

As you automate your own toil away, more of your time goes into platform and automation work.

**Products you may work on**

Sarvam builds across a broad range of AI products: voice agents, coding agents, coworker agents, dubbing, our API platform, and the real-time voice and WebRTC infrastructure underneath them, among many others. You will work on the infrastructure behind them.

**Responsibilities**

* Own infrastructure operations across Sarvam’s products: deployments, provisioning requests, access, environment issues, cost questions
* Respond to incidents, write the runbook or postmortem afterwards, and fix the cause
* Automate repeated work: turn manual steps into pipeline jobs, Terraform modules, templates or self-service for product teams
* Build AI-assisted automations: agents that triage alerts, summarise incidents, review routine changes or answer product teams’ infrastructure questions, with a human approving anything risky
* Security basics: keep images and dependencies patched, rotate credentials, keep secrets out of code, fix security findings
* Reliability basics: keep dashboards and alerts accurate, track SLOs and cost, delete noisy alerts
* Take part in on-call

**Requirements**

* 2–5 years in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure or backend engineering
* Has built infrastructure outside a ticket: a homelab, an open-source contribution, a side project, or an internal tool nobody asked for — and can show the code (GitHub, a blog post or a demo)
* Comfortable on the Linux command line: processes, networking basics, logs, systemd
* Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes; has deployed and debugged something running on a cluster
* Scripting in Python, Go or Bash
* Basic Git and CI/CD experience
* Has spotted a repeated manual task — a daily review, a recurring fix, a routine request — and built something that removed it: a script, a CI job, a bot or a Kubernetes operator. You can walk us through what you noticed, why it mattered, what you built and what it saved
* Has used LLMs or AI agents to automate real work, not only for writing code
* Fixes causes rather than the same symptom twice; asks “why is this manual?” before doing it again
* Curious, takes ownership, wants to grow into platform engineering
* Nice to have: Terraform, a public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), Prometheus / Grafana, exposure to SIP, WebRTC or real-time media, any cloud or Kubernetes certification

title: Quality Engineer , Equities Post-Trade
description:
Quality Engineer , Equities Post-Trade

**About Millennium**

Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. * Design, build, and maintain automated test coverage across Java/Spring Boot microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, Kafka event flows, batch jobs, data workflows, and user interfaces.
* Validate batch and workflow behavior, including reruns, failures, idempotency, and cache consistency between Redis and the database.
* Build data-validation and reconciliation checks to protect the integrity of setup data, positions, balances, and downstream outputs.
* Expand regression coverage and quality gates within CI pipelines to continuously validate changes.
* Track, triage, and document defects with clear reproduction steps; use logs and metrics to support root-cause analysis, verify fixes, and support release readiness through environment validation, smoke and sanity testing, access and entitlement checks, and test sign-off documentation.

**What You Bring**

  

* Prior fintech or capital-markets experience in quality engineering for pre-trade or post-trade equity systems within a hedge fund, investment bank, asset manager, or fintech organization.
* 5+ years of experience in software quality engineering and test automation.
* Hands-on knowledge of corporate actions and option expiry, including their impact on positions and P&L.
* Strong Java test-automation skills, including JUnit or TestNG, REST Assured, Spring Boot Test, and Mockito.
* Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs, including contract, schema, authentication, and entitlement validation.
* Advanced SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation; PostgreSQL experience is preferred, though experience with any relational database is welcome.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes on AWS, CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Git, and Agile delivery practices.
* A precise, analytical approach; strong written and verbal communication skills; sound judgment when using AI coding assistants; and the ability to collaborate effectively with developers, Middle Office, and Operations.

title: ELECTRICAL AND MAINTENANCE ENGINEER
description:
Dear Sir/ Madam,

Please find the attached below summary for job vacancy in Nelmangala Plant.

We are seeking a safety-first Electrical Maintenance Engineer / Technician (ITI & Diploma holders) specializing in industrial heating systems to join our furnace manufacturing unit. You will be responsible for ensuring maximum uptime of our induction/arc furnaces, high-power transformers, automated charging systems, and critical water-cooling loops while strictly adhering to high-voltage industrial safety protocols.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Core Roles & Responsibilities

For ITI Candidates (Role: Furnace Maintenance Electrician / Technician)

* Furnace Component Upkeep: Perform routine maintenance on furnace coils, busbars, high-current water-cooled cables, and capacitor banks.

* Thermal & Sensor Calibration: Regularly inspect and replace high-temperature thermocouples, RTDs, infrared sensors, and proximity switches.

* Refractory & Lining Support: Assist the mechanical team in monitoring furnace lining wear and maintaining patching/ramming equipment electrics.

* Cooling Loop Maintenance: Monitor and maintain the electrical pumps, valves, and flow switches for the furnace’s critical water-cooling emergency systems.

* Heavy Panel Dressing: Clean and inspect high-voltage control panels, Thyristor switchgears, and power distribution boards (DBs) for overheating.

* High-Risk Safety (LOTO): Strictly apply Lockout-Tagout (LOTO) and wear arc-flash PPE before entering high-voltage furnace zones.

For Diploma Candidates (Role: Junior Furnace Maintenance Engineer / Supervisor)

* HT / LT Power Distribution: Manage the operations of heavy-duty HT/LT substations, furnace transformers, Air Circuit Breakers (ACBs), and Vacuum Circuit Breakers (VCBs).

* Automation & Thyristor Tuning: Troubleshoot and fine-tune PLC/SCADA control networks (Siemens, Rockwell, etc.) and Thyristor power controllers managing the furnace heating cycles.

* Predictive & Preventive Maintenance: Draft and manage the daily, weekly, and monthly PM schedules specifically tailored for furnace power factor optimization (APFC panels) and harmonic filters.

* Emergency Interlock Management: Ensure all safety interlocks (water flow, pressure, over-temperature trips, and earth-leakage relays) are fully operational and regularly tested.

* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Diagnose structural failures in furnace coils or power surges to continuously reduce MTTR (Mean Time to Repair) and optimize energy consumption.

* Team & Logbook Supervision: Allocate tasks to a shift team of ITI technicians, maintain legal breakdown registers, and manage high-value electrical spares (thyristors, diodes, cards). \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Key Technical Competencies

* For ITI Candidates:

o Proficient in using heavy insulation testers (Megger) to check furnace coil grounding.

o Sound knowledge of hydraulic/pneumatic valves linked to furnace tilting mechanisms.

o Expertise in industrial cable crimping and dealing with flexible copper braided wires.

* For Diploma Candidates:

o Ability to interpret advanced multi-page Electrical Schematics and Control Circuit Blueprints.

o Deep understanding of PLC logic handling multi-zone temperature profiling and cooling loop automated loops.

o Power quality monitoring (handling harmonics, voltage dips, and maintaining a high Power Factor).

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Work Environment & Eligibility

* Education:

o ITI in Electrician / Wireman / Power Electronics trade.

o Diploma (Polytechnic) in Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Electronics.

* Experience: 1 to 5+ years of core maintenance experience in an induction furnace plant, foundry, steel melting shop (SMS), or glass manufacturing factory.

* Physical Conditions: Must be comfortable working in a high-temperature, high-voltage, and fast-paced continuous manufacturing environment.

* Licensing: Holding an Electrical Supervisor Permit / Workman Permit (Grade A) issued by the regional electrical licensing board is highly preferred.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team offers the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive-scale, coordinated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant environment. OCI delivers cloud products that support customers tackling some of the world’s most complex and business-critical challenges.

OCI Infrastructure Delivery Engineering is a growing organization responsible for building services and tools that accelerate how OCI expands its compute and network capacity. Our platform supports the end-to-end lifecycle of data centers and their physical assets—from planning and design, through delivery and operation, to eventual decommissioning. It enables OCI to scale efficiently in existing regions and launch new regions while meeting the high-capacity demands of large and hyperscale customers.

We are looking for a talented and passionate Senior Software Development Engineer to help design, build, and operate this foundational platform. You will work on highly available, scalable services that manage physical assets throughout their lifecycle. This is a greenfield environment with significant autonomy to innovate, while integrating with OCI systems through established service contracts.

You will be a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving challenging distributed-systems problems, values simplicity and customer impact, and takes ownership of quality in production. You will collaborate closely with engineers and partner teams to deliver reliable services that help OCI continue to grow its global footprint.

  

About You

* You are a cloud development engineer who has contributed to high-scale, high-impact solutions.
* You are customer-focused and consistently look for ways to exceed expectations.
* You communicate technical concepts clearly and work effectively with diverse partners.
* You hold yourself and your work to a high standard, continuously seeking better engineering outcomes.
* You are comfortable operating in an evolving environment and can bring structure to ambiguity.
* You are passionate about technology, able to advocate for your ideas constructively, and open to evidence-based alternatives.

Minimum Qualifications

* BS/Btech in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience, including 1+ year designing, delivering, or operating scalable, cloud-native distributed systems.
* Proficiency in one or more high-level programming languages, preferably Go and/or Java; working knowledge of scripting or automation languages such as Python.
* Experience contributing to products from the ground up through the full software development lifecycle.
* Understanding of microservice design patterns, service-to-service communication protocols, and techniques for building highly reliable services.
* Familiarity with service observability, including dashboards, critical service metrics, alarms, and operational health indicators.
* Strong grasp of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and programming paradigms.
* Experience with production operations and practices for safely deploying quality code, participating in on-call rotations, and troubleshooting incidents.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment.
* Ability to communicate technical ideas verbally and in writing through design documents, proposals, architecture diagrams, and presentations.

Preferred Qualifications

* MTech or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in a fast-paced engineering environment.
* Experience building control-plane or data-plane solutions for cloud-native platforms.
* Experience diagnosing and resolving performance, reliability, or scaling issues in complex distributed environments.
* Understanding of the physical asset lifecycle in a cloud-scale data center.
* Experience with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) systems or related tools.
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Familiarity with modern infrastructure components such as service discovery, secret storage, containerization, and software-defined networking.

Responsibilities

* Design, implement, test, deploy, and operate services and tools that accelerate OCI compute and network capacity growth.
* Work with engineers and partner teams to define and deliver reliable, scalable capabilities for the physical asset lifecycle.
* Investigate issues across the stack, resolve root causes, and improve service reliability, performance, and operational readiness.
* Apply sound distributed-systems and cloud-infrastructure principles to deliver resilient production services.
* Build and maintain meaningful service telemetry, dashboards, alarms, and runbooks to support operational excellence.
* Participate in on-call rotations and incident response; use operational learnings to drive durable improvements.
* Contribute to technical designs, architecture discussions, code reviews, and engineering standards.
* Balance speed and quality through iterative, incremental delivery and thoughtful prioritization.
* Work independently on well-defined problems and provide technical mentorship and support to junior engineers.
* Communicate progress, risks, and technical trade-offs clearly, and help build consensus using data and sound engineering judgment.

This role combines broad autonomy with the opportunity to integrate with existing OCI systems through well-established contracts. You will influence the direction of a foundational platform at cloud scale and help shape how OCI continues to grow its global footprint.

  

About You

* You are a hands-on cloud engineer and technical leader with a record of delivering high-scale, high-impact distributed systems.
* You turn ambiguous business and infrastructure problems into clear technical strategy, phased execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
* You care deeply about customers and consistently make sound trade-offs among reliability, security, velocity, simplicity, and cost.
* You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, product leaders, and partner teams.
* You set a high engineering bar, use data to build consensus, and constructively challenge assumptions.
* You thrive in a fast-moving environment, take ownership across organizational boundaries, and mentor engineers at multiple levels.

Minimum Qualifications

* BS/BTech in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial experience designing, shipping, and operating scalable, cloud-native distributed systems.
* Demonstrated technical leadership for complex, multi-service initiatives, including architecture definition, technical roadmaps, design reviews, and delivery across multiple teams.
* Strong proficiency in one or more high-level programming languages, preferably Go and/or Java; proficiency with scripting or automation languages such as Python.
* Deep experience with distributed-systems fundamentals, microservice design patterns, service-to-service communication, data consistency, fault tolerance, and highly available service design.
* Experience designing production services with robust observability, including service-level indicators/objectives, dashboards, metrics, alarms, capacity planning, and operational runbooks.
* Proven production-operations experience, including incident response, root-cause analysis, on-call practices, and driving systemic reliability improvements.
* Strong foundation in computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and programming paradigms.
* Ability to author and communicate technical proposals, architecture documents, design specifications, and presentations for diverse audiences.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.

Preferred Qualifications

* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience building control-plane and/or data-plane solutions for a cloud provider or other large-scale infrastructure company.
* Experience with the physical asset lifecycle in cloud-scale data centers, including planning, delivery, inventory, deployment, maintenance, and decommissioning.
* Experience with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) systems, capacity-planning tools, or physical infrastructure workflows.
* Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and modern infrastructure components such as service discovery, secret storage, containerization, and software-defined networking.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Experience diagnosing and resolving complex performance, scaling, and reliability issues in large distributed environments.
* Track record of establishing technical standards, reusable platform capabilities, or engineering practices adopted across teams.

Responsibilities

* Own and evolve the technical architecture for services and tools that accelerate OCI compute and network capacity growth.
* Lead the design and delivery of resilient, scalable, secure, and operable services for the end-to-end physical asset lifecycle.
* Translate long-term business and infrastructure goals into technical strategy, architecture roadmaps, and sequenced execution plans.
* Remain hands-on: prototype critical paths, review code and designs, solve difficult technical problems, and guide implementation of high-risk components.
* Drive alignment across engineering, product, operations, security, and partner organizations; establish clear interfaces and durable integration contracts.
* Define and champion operational-excellence standards, including observability, service health, incident learning, capacity planning, and reliability goals.
* Identify systemic risks, technical debt, and scaling bottlenecks; prioritize improvements using customer impact and data-driven analysis.
* Raise the technical bar through architectural reviews, engineering standards, technical mentorship, and constructive feedback.
* Influence major decisions for new and existing products, build consensus around trade-offs, and communicate decisions clearly to stakeholders.
* Foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning, simplicity, and iterative delivery while balancing speed with quality.

title: Director, Software Engineering
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
===============

The Acceptance Solutions Product Development team are the engineers responsible for a portfolio of products that drive diversification of Visa revenue, differentiate our network, and deliver value-added solutions across other rails. This is part of a strategy to increase total merchant value by developing solutions that address complex and emerging needs of both merchants and acquirers. Our mission is to drive the future of payment acceptance, helping our clients navigate digital commerce complexities and address an increasing need for flexibility and agility.

The goal of the Visa Acceptance Platform is to be the world’s most open payment platform by delivering market leading, globally relevant, omnichannel acceptance componentry through open, composable, modular APIs delivered with Visa-grade resilience, security, maintenance, and scale.

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on engineering leader to lead teams building secure, high-performing distributed systems for payment acceptance. Our technology stack includes Java, Containers, Kafka, relational databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern cloud-native engineering practices. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering depth, proven people leadership, and the ability to stay close to day-to-day design, code, architecture, delivery, and operational decisions while partnering with architecture, product, security, and operations teams to deliver resilient platforms at scale.

This role requires a leader who can balance strategic direction with active hands-on engineering involvement, apply AI/ML and Generative AI to improve engineering productivity and business outcomes, and mentor engineers to grow their technical capabilities and careers. This is an opportunity to lead talented teams while remaining deeply engaged in the technical details that shape secure, scalable payment acceptance. Be a part of our mission to shape the future of secure payments.

**Essential Functions**
=======================

* Serve as the hands-on technical lead for Payment Processing Platform across the Visa Acceptance Platform, providing technical direction across architecture, design, implementation, scalability, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Lead the design, implementation, and deployment of secure, reliable, robust, and interoperable payment acceptance products.
* Provide engineering leadership to ensure solutions align with platform principles, architecture standards, and Visa-grade availability, resiliency, and operational excellence expectations.
* Remain actively hands-on with architecture, design reviews, code reviews, proof-of-concepts, performance analysis, debugging, technical troubleshooting, production-readiness, and critical delivery decisions on a day-to-day basis.
* Apply AI/ML, Generative AI, automation, and intelligent engineering practices to improve software delivery, search relevance, analytics capabilities, operational insight, developer productivity, and business outcomes.
* Define and execute the technical strategy for payment processing and acceptance platforms in alignment with product vision, business priorities, and long-term platform evolution.
* Drive delivery of fit-for-purpose products and platform capabilities that improve time-to-market while maintaining security, quality, scalability, and reliability.
* Design and evolve secure, reliable, and scalable search, indexing, analytics, enrichment, and data-processing capabilities that support high-volume payment acceptance use cases.
* Provide technical leadership for modern, intuitive, secure, and performant user interfaces that enable search, analytics, reporting, operational insights, and data-driven workflows for internal and external users.
* Set technical direction for event-driven data flows, transaction enrichment, search indexing, analytics pipelines, user-facing dashboards, observability, and operational insights in alignment with product, platform, security, user experience, and business objectives.
* Lead technical design for event correlation, transaction matching, retry handling, dead-letter queues, replay, idempotency, exactly-once processing considerations, and high-throughput data movement.
* Establish and continuously improve engineering best practices for application development, testing, deployment, observability, monitoring, incident response, and operational readiness, strengthening reliability, performance, maintainability, developer productivity, and operational excellence across Search and Analytics capabilities.
* Partner with application, data, platform, product, regional, business, client-facing, security, privacy, risk, governance, compliance, and operations teams to translate requirements into high-quality solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements (security, latency, availability, compliance, maintainability) and applicable policies, standards, regulatory expectations, and customer commitments.
* Communicate and present technical strategy, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, delivery progress, and recommendations clearly, adapting to audiences that include executive leaders, business partners, product partners, architecture forums, and engineering teams.
* Coach, mentor, and develop engineers, senior engineers, technical leads, and engineering leaders through regular feedback, design reviews, architecture discussions, hands-on problem solving, technical deep dives, brown bag sessions, tech talks, production troubleshooting, and career development conversations.
* Build and lead high-performing teams by promoting collaboration, constructive debate, accountability, inclusion, and execution excellence consistent with Visa Leadership Principles.
* Bring forward new ideas, engineering improvements, and technology recommendations that increase team effectiveness, improve developer productivity, and advance platform capabilities.
* Influence technical strategy across teams without relying on formal reporting authority, using strong engineering judgment, collaboration, credibility, and hands-on technical depth.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**
========================

* 10+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 13+ years of relevant work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD.
* Demonstrated success leading high-performing, multi-disciplinary, and geographically distributed software engineering teams, including people management, coaching, performance development, delivery accountability, and hiring, developing, and retaining senior technical talent.
* Deep experience designing, building, and operating globally distributed, mission-critical systems that require high availability, scalability, resiliency, and security, and that support very high transaction volumes with strict availability, latency, security, and compliance requirements.
* Proven ability to solve complex technical and organizational problems across multiple domains, systems, and teams.
* Experience setting technical direction, influencing architecture and delivery strategy, and aligning engineering execution with product and business objectives.
* Strong proficiency in modern software engineering practices, programming languages, API design, system design, testing, deployment, and operational excellence, with a strong hands-on background in API-first software product development using technologies such as Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Vert.x, REST, Kafka, Hazelcast, Git, Maven, CI/CD pipelines, and test automation.
* Recent hands-on experience with architecture, design, coding practices, code reviews, debugging, production support, and technical decision-making in complex software systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms, Kubernetes, containerized deployment models, and modern DevOps practices.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, streaming platforms such as Kafka, and high-throughput transaction or data processing systems, including resilient patterns such as event correlation, transaction matching, retry mechanisms, dead-letter queues, replay, idempotency, and exactly-once processing considerations.
* Experience delivering secure software platforms, including familiarity with authentication, authorization, encryption, identity, and secure engineering practices.
* rack record of mentoring engineers, developing technical leaders, and building strong engineering culture.
* Experience applying AI-enabled engineering practices, automation, or developer productivity improvements across software delivery teams, and implementing, deploying, or governing AI/ML, Generative AI, or agentic AI capabilities in production environments or engineering workflows.
* Experience in payments, financial services, fintech, or high-scale transaction processing environments, including payment processing, transaction lifecycle concepts, payment network protocols, and acceptance workflows.
* Experience partnering with executive leadership, product leaders, technical product managers, regional teams, and business stakeholders to define strategy, roadmaps, requirements, priorities, and delivery plans.
* Experience with financial services compliance, risk, and control requirements such as PCI-DSS, SOX, security standards, audit readiness, and operational controls.
* Strong experience with agile delivery, software development lifecycle practices, engineering metrics, continuous improvement, developer productivity, and operational performance management.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to form, advocate, and communicate an independent technical viewpoint grounded in hands-on engineering experience.
* Long-term strategic thinker who stays current with emerging technologies and translates them into practical engineering and business outcomes.
* Highly driven, resourceful, results-oriented, and collaborative, with strong communication skills and a focus on durable, win-win outcomes.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------

Team Management: Mgr. Systems Architects manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects, lead architects, and associate managers, assigning them to the right Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
  
Guidance and Mentorship: They guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently, mentor reportees, and ensure they contribute towards achieving business goals and managing technical debt.
  
Architectural Oversight: They oversee system design and roadmap, drive architectural initiatives, identify opportunities for optimization, and ensure designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT guidelines.
  
Coordination Across ARTs: Mgr. Systems Architects ensure technology alignments across ARTs, confirm capabilities meet Definition of Ready (DoR), and review estimates and critical features by working with other architects.
  
Production Performance and Stability: They maintain full awareness of application performance in production environments, participate in SWAT calls to address stability issues, and help document root causes.
  
Engagement and Collaboration: They engage with system architects, outside vendors, and various teams to review and ensure the success of designs, and participate in Continuous Exploration processes.

* Guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently
* Enable system architects in the team to own and contribute towards achieving business goals and technical debt.
* Understand overall system design and roadmap
* Drive architectural initiatives and identify opportunities for optimization
* Oversee, mentor and guide reportees.
* Identify areas where POCs are required and assign to reportees as appropriate and track the same to completion.

* Ensure technology alignments across ARTs; align teams of multiple ARTs to a shared technical direction by working with respective ART System architects

* Collaborate with their application/service development team, Load and Performance team, chaos engineering team, SRE SPOC etc.
* Have full awareness of application/service performance in production environment, upstream / downstream applications, database performance characteristics etc.
* Participate in Proactive / Reactive SWAT calls to address production stability issues, help teams on identifying and documenting accurate root cause of issues.
* Review ART technical enabler Feature content
* Review ART environment performance, stability, and scalability targets
* Review critical nonfunctional requirements. Provide inputs based on production stability, performance issues, bottle necks, User experience issues, security etc.
* Review ART system designs focused on system components which align to the larger end state designs
* Review ART technical system design documents
* Review deisgn of subsystems and their interfaces; allocate responsibilities to subsystems; understand design deployment; communicate requirements for interactions within design context.
* Review ART data flow, sources, storage, format
* Review technical and architectural vision for the ARTs and provide inputs to system architects

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

* Minimum 10 years of software development experience, with deep expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework / EF Core, and LINQ.
* At least 3 years in a solution/application architect role, an engineering manager role, or both.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong expertise in microservices, API design, distributed systems, and design patterns (including SOLID, domain-driven design, CQRS, and event-driven architecture).
* Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server: data modeling, complex T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, query and performance tuning, execution plans, and transaction and locking behavior.
* Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of application security, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD / Entra ID, secrets management, and secure handling of sensitive financial data.
* Experience with observability and production support tools such as Application Insights and Azure Monitor.
* Experience leading Agile/Scrum teams using Jira (Confluence is a plus).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across time zones with US-based leadership and business teams.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
  

* AI/ML: experience designing or delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered solutions (RAG, agents, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning).
* Palantir: exposure to Palantir Foundry or AIP.
* Python: hands-on experience with Python for services, automation, or data work.
* Multi-cloud: experience architecting across AWS or Google Cloud in addition to Azure.
* Containers and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or Bicep.
* Front-end architecture experience with Angular, React, or Blazor.
* Experience with messaging and streaming platforms (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).
* Domain knowledge in billing, payments, invoicing, collections, revenue management, or other financial systems, ideally in telecom or large enterprise.

  

What We're Looking For
  

* A leader who balances hands-on technical depth with strong people management.
* A strategic thinker who can set a clear technical direction and turn it into practical delivery plans.
* Someone who builds trust across teams and time zones through clear, proactive communication.
* A mentor who enjoys developing engineers and raising the bar for the whole team.

title: Senior Manager - System Validation
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**THE ROLE:**

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead System Validation for BIOS, Firmware and Driver validation activities across our embedded product portfolio. This role will provide hands-on technical leadership, drive validation coverage, strengthen test planning and execution discipline, and ensure timely visibility to critical issues, risks and customer-impacting defects. The leader will work closely with development, silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, platform and customer-facing teams to ensure validation readiness, reduce test escapes and improve engineering effectiveness through scale and AI-driven initiatives.

**THE PERSON**

* A strong technical validation leader with deep understanding of system-level validation across BIOS, firmware, drivers and platform software stacks.
* Demonstrates ownership in defining validation coverage, test strategy, execution governance and defect triage for complex silicon and platform programs.
* Builds trusted networks across client and server ecosystems, development teams, silicon IP enablement teams and validation organizations to improve end-to-end product readiness.
* Balances technical depth with people leadership, helping the team grow in capability, execution maturity, collaboration and customer orientation.
* Brings a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to drive scale, automation, traceability and AI-enabled productivity across validation workflows.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide technical leadership for system validation activities covering BIOS, firmware and driver validation across assigned embedded programs.
* Define and drive the right validation coverage by partnering with architecture, development, silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, platform and customer enablement teams.
* Own test management discipline including validation planning, test readiness, execution tracking, completion governance and timely reporting of progress, gaps and risks.
* Drive first-level triage for critical issues by ensuring structured debug data collection, clear ownership alignment, prioritization and timely handoff to the appropriate development teams.
* Establish strong collaboration forums with BIOS, firmware, driver, silicon IP, silicon validation and platform teams to close coverage gaps and improve defect discovery earlier in the lifecycle.
* Build and maintain technical connects in the client and server spaces from which the group leverages devices, ecosystems, validation methodologies and learnings.
* Reduce validation escapes through improved test strategy, coverage analysis, defect trend reviews, regression rigor and disciplined exit criteria.
* Support customer escalations and critical field issue triage as required, ensuring responsiveness, technical clarity and coordinated execution across engineering owners.
* Lead team development by coaching engineers and leads, improving technical depth, strengthening ownership behaviors and building succession for key validation areas.
* Drive scale initiatives across validation execution, including automation, reusable test assets, consistent dashboards, traceability from requirements to tests, and execution efficiency improvements.
* Champion AI initiatives that improve test planning, coverage mapping, traceability, execution tracking, defect analytics, reporting quality and validation productivity.
* Partner with program management and engineering leadership to provide accurate status, risk visibility, decision points and recovery plans for validation milestones.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* 20+ years of industry experience with 8+ years of exposure with people management roles
* Experience leading system validation, post-silicon validation, platform validation, BIOS validation, firmware validation or driver validation teams for complex silicon or platform products.
* Strong understanding of validation lifecycle, test plan development, coverage definition, test execution governance, defect management, regression strategy and exit criteria.
* Hands-on familiarity with BIOS, UEFI, firmware, drivers, platform initialization, silicon bring-up, debug flows and system-level validation environments.
* Experience collaborating with silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, firmware, BIOS, driver, platform, architecture and customer-facing teams.
* Demonstrated ability to lead issue triage, drive technical discussions, identify ownership, escalate risks and close critical defects with urgency.
* Experience with customer escalations, field issue debug, escape analysis and corrective action planning.
* Working knowledge of test management tools, defect tracking systems, coverage dashboards, automation frameworks and traceability practices.
* Experience applying automation, data analytics or AI-assisted methods to improve validation planning, execution tracking, reporting or defect insights.
* Prior people management experience with demonstrated ability to hire, coach, develop and retain high-performing validation engineers and leads.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present validation status, risks, technical issues and execution plans to engineering and business leadership.

**Academic Credentials**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical discipline.
* Equivalent industry experience in system validation, firmware, BIOS, driver, silicon validation or platform engineering will be considered.

=================

The Detection Engineer supports the development, testing, tuning, and maintenance of cyber detection capabilities across the Security Operations Centre (SOC). Working closely with SOC analysts, threat intelligence, incident response, and engineering teams, this role helps improve visibility, detection accuracy, and response effectiveness. This is an early-career position designed for individuals looking to build expertise in detection engineering, SIEM content development, threat analytics, and automation. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity, analytical reasoning, and the ability to independently investigate why a detection fired, how an attack could occur, and how future detections can be improved.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Support the development, testing, and maintenance of SIEM detection rules, analytics, alerts, and correlation logic.
* Assist with tuning existing detections to reduce false positives and improve detection quality.
* Investigate missed detections and support root-cause analysis activities.
* Work with SOC analysts to understand alert triage outcomes and improve detection content.
* Help onboard new log sources into monitoring platforms and validate data quality and coverage.
* Support detection use-case development using threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, incident findings, and known attack techniques.
* Participate in threat hunting exercises and assist with developing new detection opportunities.
* Assist with maintaining detection engineering documentation, standards, playbooks, and testing records.
* Support development of automation workflows within SIEM, SOAR, and response platforms.
* Assist the SOC in the triage, investigation, and response of security alerts, incidents, and escalations
* Contribute to purple-team, tabletop, and validation exercises to measure effectiveness of detections.
* Track detection performance metrics, including false positives, false negatives, detection coverage, and alert quality.
* Support continuous improvement activities following incidents, audits, and lessons learned reviews.
* Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 1–3 years experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, SOC operations, system administration, or related technical field.
* Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals including phishing, malware, identity attacks, network attacks, and incident response.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted detection engineering, large language models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and security automation platforms used to improve analyst productivity and detection outcomes.
* Basic knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis concepts.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, authentication, and firewalls.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to learn quickly and work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, Microsoft Defender, Azure, AWS, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing, integrating, or operationalizing AI-powered analysis, automation, and agent-based workflows within security operations, incident response, or detection engineering functions.
* Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Basic scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, KQL, or SQL.
* Security+, SC-200, AZ-500, CySA+, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience participating in labs, CTFs, internships, threat hunting, or cyber research projects.
  

  

**Success Measures**
====================

* Improvement in detection quality and reduction in false positives.
* Successful onboarding and validation of data sources.
* Delivery of new and enhanced detection use cases.
* Contribution to incident-driven detection improvements.
* Accurate documentation and testing of detection logic.

title: Service AMC Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**A. HVAC Test Rig Service & Maintenance**

* Provide technical service and maintenance support for HVAC testing laboratory equipment and test rigs.
* Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance of:
* HVAC test chambers
* Calorimeter / psychrometric test systems
* Airflow test systems
* Refrigeration test circuits
* Cooling/heating systems
* Condensing units
* AHU / air-handling systems
* Pumps and fans
* Heat exchangers
* Compressors
* Valves and actuators.
* Identify abnormal operation and take corrective action.
* Maintain test rigs in operational condition with minimum downtime.
* Develop preventive maintenance schedules for laboratory equipment.

**B. Instrumentation & Measurement Systems**

* Service and troubleshoot laboratory measurement instruments such as:
* Temperature sensors
* Humidity sensors
* Pressure sensors/transducers
* Differential pressure sensors
* Airflow measurement devices
* Flow meters
* Energy/power meters
* Refrigerant temperature/pressure sensors
* RTDs / thermocouples
* Load cells, wherever applicable.
* Check sensor health and identify abnormal or unstable readings.
* Support sensor replacement and configuration.
* Coordinate calibration activities with approved laboratories.
* Maintain calibration records and instrument history.

**C. Data Acquisition & Control Systems**

* Troubleshoot **DAQ systems, PLCs, controllers, HMI and laboratory control systems**.
* Identify communication failures between sensors, PLC, DAQ and software.
* Support troubleshooting of:
* PLC I/O
* Analog/digital signals
* Communication networks
* Data logging systems
* HMI alarms
* Controller faults
* Software/hardware communication issues.
* Coordinate with system integrators/OEMs for complex software and control-system issues.
* Verify correct data acquisition after repairs.

**D. Refrigeration System Troubleshooting**

* Troubleshoot refrigeration circuits used in HVAC testing facilities.
* Diagnose:
* Compressor problems
* High/low pressure conditions
* Refrigerant leakage
* Refrigerant flow issues
* Expansion valve problems
* Condenser/evaporator performance
* Oil/refrigerant-related issues.
* Check refrigeration operating parameters and identify abnormal trends.
* Support refrigerant recovery, charging and leak testing as per applicable procedures.

**E. Test Chamber & Environmental Control**

* Maintain environmental test chambers and associated systems.
* Monitor and troubleshoot:
* Temperature control
* Humidity control
* Air circulation
* Heating systems
* Cooling systems
* Control valves
* Dampers
* Fans and blowers.
* Support chamber performance verification and validation.
* Ensure the laboratory can achieve required test conditions consistently.

**F. Calibration & Measurement Accuracy**

* Maintain an updated calibration schedule for laboratory instruments.
* Ensure only calibrated/approved instruments are used for testing.
* Support calibration and verification of:
* Temperature
* Pressure
* Humidity
* Airflow
* Electrical power
* Flow
* Other critical measurement parameters.
* Investigate measurement deviations and abnormal readings.
* Support uncertainty/measurement accuracy investigations where applicable.

**G. Breakdown Support**

* Attend laboratory breakdowns and restore equipment operation within the required timeline.
* Diagnose problems systematically rather than replacing components without identifying the root cause.
* Maintain breakdown records.
* Conduct RCA for major or repeated laboratory failures.
* Recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain critical spare-parts requirements.

**H. Documentation**

Maintain:

* Preventive maintenance records
* Breakdown reports
* Calibration records
* Test-rig history
* Instrument history
* Spare-parts records
* Service reports
* RCA/CAPA reports
* OEM service records
* Test-rig operating checklists.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
