title: Software Development Engineer II - Multichannel Agents
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Blue Machines AI builds a production AI agent platform that large enterprise customers use to automate customer conversations at scale. Today a single agent may take a phone call, answer a WhatsApp message, pick up a chat on a customer's website, or join a video session — and it has to behave like the same agent everywhere: same knowledge, same business rules, same memory of who the customer is and what they asked for five minutes ago on a different channel.

The Multichannel team owns that layer. We build the channel adapters, the session and conversation model that sits above them, and the media handling that lets an agent move between text, audio, video, images and documents. Every channel has its own protocol, its own constraints and its own way of failing: telephony cares about milliseconds and codecs, WhatsApp about template approvals, 24-hour session windows and delivery receipts, the web widget about reconnects, flaky mobile networks and embedding inside someone else's site. A bug here isn't a broken screen — it's an enterprise customer's support line going silent.

We're hiring an SDE II to help build this team's foundations. You'll design and ship channel integrations end to end, own them in production, and help define the abstractions that make adding the next channel a week of work instead of a quarter.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and own channel integrations — WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), telephony (SIP/PSTN via carriers and CPaaS providers), the embeddable web chat widget, and in-app/web voice and video over WebRTC — from API design through production on-call.
* Design the unified conversation layer: a channel-agnostic session, message and identity model so the agent runtime sees one conversation regardless of where it came from, with clean handling of channel switches (e.g., a call that continues on WhatsApp) and cross-channel context.
* Handle multimodal input and output: text, voice notes, live audio streams, video, images, documents, location, interactive messages (buttons, lists, carousels) — normalising inbound media for the agent and rendering agent responses correctly for each channel's capabilities and limits.
* Build the realtime plumbing: WebSockets/WebRTC for live audio and video, streaming responses to the widget, and the hooks into the voice pipeline (STT, TTS, turn detection, barge-in) owned with Team Orca.
* Make delivery reliable: idempotent webhook ingestion, retries and dead-letter handling, ordering guarantees, delivery/read-status tracking, rate-limit and quality-tier management on WhatsApp, and graceful degradation when a provider is down.
* Ship the web widget as a product: lightweight embeddable SDK, theming and configuration from our Console, reconnect and offline behaviour, attachment uploads, accessibility, and security for running inside third-party pages.
* Own it in production: instrument latency, delivery success and error rates per channel; build dashboards and alerts; debug live incidents across our services, carrier/BSP logs and customer networks.
* Write design docs, review code, and raise the bar on testing for asynchronous, event-driven systems. Use AI coding tools as a normal part of how you work — with no compromise on quality.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3–6 years building and running backend or full-stack systems in production, with clear ownership of at least one service end to end.
* Strong in one of Python, Go, Node.js/TypeScript or Java, and comfortable reading the others.
* Solid fundamentals in distributed, event-driven systems: queues/streams (Kafka, Redis Streams, RabbitMQ, SQS or similar), async processing, idempotency, retries, and consistency trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience integrating at least one messaging or communication channel — WhatsApp Business API, SMS, telephony/CPaaS (Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, Vonage or similar), or a chat platform — including webhooks, signature verification and provider-specific quirks.
* Working knowledge of realtime protocols: WebSockets, and ideally WebRTC or streaming media.
* Comfortable designing APIs and data models (SQL and NoSQL) that will be used by other teams and by customers.
* Production instincts: you reach for logs, traces and metrics before guessing, and you design for failure because providers will fail.
* Clear written communication — your design docs and incident notes should stand on their own.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Built a chat or voice widget/SDK embedded in third-party websites or mobile apps.
* Experience with SIP, RTP, media servers (FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, LiveKit, Janus, mediasoup) or codecs and audio processing.
* Familiarity with WhatsApp specifics: template messages, 24-hour customer-service window, interactive messages, Flows, BSP integrations, quality ratings and messaging limits.
* Experience with LLM-based or conversational AI products, especially streaming responses or voice agents.
* Exposure to additional channels: RCS, Instagram/Messenger, Telegram, email, or in-app chat.
* Performance and load-testing realtime systems at high concurrency.

**Why Blue Machines**
---------------------

You'll be an early engineer on a new team with a broad charter — the abstractions you design will decide how every future channel gets built. You'll work on hard, visible problems at enterprise scale, close to the architects and the people who own the platform, with real ownership over what ships.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure and maintain SIEM content, including log sources, parsing, correlation rules, dashboards, alerts, and reports.
* Ingest and normalize security events from cloud, endpoint, network, identity, and application sources.
* Tune detections to reduce noise, improve signal quality, and support timely response.
* Support security tooling across SIEM, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, and CSPM platforms.
* Integrate security alerts and workflows with ServiceNow, Jira, and related ticketing tools.
* Partner with threat detection, incident response, and platform teams to investigate events and improve coverage.
* Maintain documentation, runbooks, policies, and procedures for security tooling and integrations.
* Monitor tool health and data quality, and troubleshoot issues in ingestion, visibility, and alerting.
* Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and security best practices.
* Mentor team members and share practical guidance on SIEM engineering and data analysis.

**How You Will Do It**
----------------------

* You take ownership of security outcomes with accountability, integrity, and a strong focus on safe operations.
* You stay close to the work, remove friction for your customers, and focus on the logs, detections, and integrations that matter most.
* You use data, feedback, and root-cause analysis to improve detection quality and make the environment better every day.
* You collaborate across security, IT, and business teams, sharing knowledge and building trust to win as one team.
* You validate changes carefully, document your work clearly, and keep support teams informed so the environment remains reliable and easy to operate.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information security, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5 to 10 years of experience in IT security, security operations, or security engineering.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, or Logscale.

title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Keep GSK’s standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section.

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK’s Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment.

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Platform ownership:** run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner’s backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* **Reliability:** achieve 99.9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred.
* **Everything as code:** manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged.
* **Secure by default:** enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards.
* **Golden paths:** build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team’s time.
* **AI Agentic automation:** Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails.
* **Compliance:** keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline.
* **Toolchain rationalisation:** be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting.
* **Developer experience:** measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours.
* **Leadership:** set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect’s reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).
* **Area of Specialisation**
* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

  

* Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts.undefined
* Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
* Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
* Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).

  

* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.

  

* Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.

Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.

Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.

Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.

Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

Agentic AI, API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevOps Engineering, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Software Engineering, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Performance Testing Engineer (AI)
  
JLL | Full-Time
  
About the Role
  
JLL is rolling out AI agents, LLM-powered applications, and the platforms behind them across the business. Before they reach thousands of users, they need to prove they are fast, stable, and affordable at scale.
  
You will own performance engineering for your assigned portfolio of applications and AI systems. The Center of Excellence in our central AI team gives you the methodology, the platform, and the patterns; the business gives you the systems, the SMEs, and the appetite for change. Your job is to design and run load, stress, and resilience tests, find bottlenecks before production does, and turn the results into clear recommendations that teams act on.
  
We expect engineers at this level to operate with AI tools as a primary part of their workflow. You will use AI to generate test scripts, model realistic workloads, analyze results, and automate reporting. Your leverage comes from the skills, workflows, and automations you build to test safely and repeatedly. The leverage in this role is AI, not headcount.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
Design and run performance, load, stress, soak, and scalability tests for applications, APIs, and data pipelines, in close partnership with developers and business SMEs.
  
Performance-test AI systems (LLM gateway, shared RAG services, MCP servers, and agents), measuring time to first token, end-to-end latency, throughput, concurrency limits, rate-limit behavior, and token cost per transaction.
  
**Build AI-assisted test automation:** use LLMs and agents to generate scripts, create realistic synthetic workloads and data, triage results, and draft reports.
  
Integrate performance tests into CI/CD pipelines with SLO-based thresholds and gates so regressions are caught before release.
  
Instrument and monitor systems with observability tooling, diagnose bottlenecks across the application, database, network, and infrastructure layers, and recommend fixes.
  
Build evaluation harnesses that track AI output quality alongside performance, so speed and cost optimizations do not quietly degrade answers.
  
Run workshops with engineering and business teams on performance testing practices and on using tools like Claude Code in testing workflows.
  
Feed benchmarks, patterns, anti-patterns, and platform gaps back into the Center of Excellence so the next engagement moves faster.
  
  
Must Have Experience
  
Hands-on performance testing of production systems using tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling, or Locust.
  
Production-quality code in at least one of Python, JavaScript/Node, or Java/.NET, enough to build custom load generators and test automation.
  
Experience with observability and APM tools (such as Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Grafana, or Azure Monitor) and with analyzing metrics, traces, and logs to find root causes.
  
Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS) and containers, and of how relational, NoSQL, and vector data stores behave under load.
  
Used AI tools or LLM APIs in real engineering or testing workflows, with a grounded understanding of how LLM systems behave under load: token limits, rate limiting, streaming, caching, and concurrency.
  
  
Traits
  
Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain results and risk to non-engineers.
  
Pragmatic judgment on what to test, how deep to go, and when results are good enough to ship.
  
Systems thinking with a focus on failure modes; AI helps write the tests, you own the results.
  
Comfort running multiple agents and automations in parallel as part of daily workflow.
  
  
Why This Role
  
JLL. A Fortune 200 company and a global leader in commercial real estate, with the stability of a $20B+ business and the resources to invest seriously in AI.
  
The team. You sit at the seam of the business, product, and engineering, with a direct line into JLL's central AI platform via the Center of Excellence. Your findings are visible from business leadership on down.
  
The role. The systems you test are the agents and platforms thousands of JLL employees rely on every day, and your work decides whether they hold up at scale. You will see the impact within weeks, not quarters.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
At JLL, we harness the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to efficiently accelerate meaningful connections between candidates and opportunities. Using AI capabilities, we analyze your application for relevant skills, experiences, and qualifications to generate valuable insights about how your unique profile aligns with the specific requirements of the role you're pursuing.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Cyber Manager - Threat Exposure Management (Infrastructure)
description:
**Job Role- Cyber Manager**  
The Cyber Manager for Threat Exposure Management is responsible for leading [as a people manager] the enterprise-wide operations, and continual evolution of the organisation’s threat exposure management lifecycle and reduction programmes within a given scope, and reports to the *Senior Cyber Manager – Threat Exposure Management* . This role ensures that exposures across infrastructure, applications, identities, cloud, OT/IoT, AI, and third-party ecosystems are proactively identified, prioritised, validated, and remediated in alignment with business risk and operational resilience requirements.

The successful candidate must demonstrate a strong track record in leading [also as a people manager] high-performing technical teams and fostering a culture of technical excellence. They will bring market-proven know-how to establish industry-driven threat exposure management practices, whilst effectively influencing stakeholders across the organisation. The candidate must also bring advanced technical expertise in threat exposure, vulnerability management and defensive and offensive security, with the ability to lead deep technical discussions and conduct complex analysis across some of the following technologies: IT, OT, Cloud, Applications, Data, Identities, Code and AI-driven environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the technical direction and operational governance of Threat Exposure and Vulnerability Management across heterogeneous environments, including enterprise IT, OT/ICS systems (PLC, SCADA, DCS), multi-cloud architectures (such as Azure, AWS, GCP), container platforms, Kubernetes clusters, application stacks, CI/CD pipelines, Data, Identity, source-code repositories and AI/ML ecosystems.
* Oversee the full threat exposure lifecycle: continuous asset discovery, authenticated scanning, passive/active enumeration, exploitability analysis, threat correlation, prioritisation logic, risk acceptance workflows and exception governance.
* Ensure end-to-end integration with asset intelligence platforms, CMDB, CSPM, vulnerability scanners, code-security toolchains (SAST, SCA, DAST, IaC, secret scanning), and ASM/EASM technologies, establishing high-fidelity visibility across all attack-surface domains.
* Collaborate with Threat Intelligence to operationalise threat-led prioritisation, mapping exploit campaigns, adversary TTPs and industry-specific threat trends to internal exposure data. Align Vulnerability Management (VM) and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) with predictive models and real-time intel feeds.
* Direct technical coordination with Red Team and Incident Response to validate exploit paths, confirm actual attack feasibility, and translate validation findings into actionable remediation and control enhancements, partnering with Protect capability and Issues Engineers.
* Govern cloud exposure management across CSPs, ensuring deep visibility into misconfigurations, identity privileges, network paths, storage exposures, API endpoints and container orchestration layers.
* Extend VM and CTEM coverage into OT/ICS environments with risk-aware, non-disruptive methods. Coordinate with OT Security teams to identify vulnerabilities, weak configurations, outdated firmware, and unmanaged assets.

  + Practical experience with containerized applications, automated testing, and CI/CD.

  + Ability to independently design and deliver moderately complex software components and features.

  + Experience troubleshooting applications and distributed services in development, integration, or production environments.

  **Preferred / Differentiating Experience**

  + Industrial IoT or connected-device platforms

  + Hybrid-cloud or multi-cloud platforms

  + Air-gapped or restricted-connectivity environments

  + Large-scale telemetry or event-processing systems

  + Kubernetes-based edge deployments

  + Time-series databases

  + Device and gateway management

  + Secure software-development lifecycle practices

  

* Design and develop containerized microservices and distributed platform components.

description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

The Marvell Advanced Packaging team is responsible for package designs  
that meet challenging electrical requirements. High speed signaling and challenging power delivery networks require complex and custom solutions to meet constantly advancing application needs. Many of the new designs require multi-chip and multiple component configurations with high-speed IP requirements. In addition, our team is advancing Marvell's expertise in 3D packaging, Co-packaged optics and cutting-edge substrate materials. We work with the world's leading manufacturers to solve our client's most challenging designs and integrations with industry-leading packaging techniques.

**What You Can Expect**

**What You Can Expect**

* Marvell’s Central Engineering team is seeking a talented High-speed IC package development engineer to contribute to the development of advanced microelectronic packages.
* The engineer will be responsible for driving microelectronic package development from concept through tapeout, working with package architects and technical leads to select appropriate technologies and ensure manufacturability, performance, reliability, and cost compliance.

**What We're Looking For**

**What We're Looking For**

  

* 4+ years of related professional experience.

* Proficiency with industry-standard IC package layout tools such as Cadence APD or Siemens (Mentor) Xpedition (XPD)
* Strong understanding of IC package design requirements for high-speed interfaces, including constraints definition and implementation
* Experience collaborating with substrate suppliers, OSATs, and silicon fabrication partners to drive successful design execution
* Expertise in power plane design, including translating system-level power delivery requirements into optimized package solutions
* Knowledge of IC packaging technologies, materials, substrate design rules, and assembly constraints
* Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) from concept through development and production is a plus
* Ability to collaborate with ASIC physical design teams to optimize die floorplan for improved package integration and system performance is a plus
* Knowledge of 2D, 2.5D, and emerging packaging architectures such as CoWoS‑S/R/L, EMIB, CPO, and CPC.
* High‑level understanding of thermal and mechanical package constraints (e.g., warpage, TIM).
* Experience contributing to tool, process, and flow development, including library maintenance and basic scripting for automation.
* Familiarity with foundry design rules and substrate manufacturing constraints.
* Demonstrated ability to work across cross‑functional teams and global time zones; strong interpersonal skills and willingness to learn.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. title: Senior Cyber Engineer - Security Logging & Data Platforms
description:
The Senior Cyber Engineer - Security Logging & Data Platforms is responsible for the hands-on engineering, operation and continuous improvement of the organisation's end-to-end security logging and telemetry capability.
  
The role works across the complete data pipeline, from collection at source through transport, processing, optimisation, routing and storage to SIEM and other authorised security consumers. The engineer ensures telemetry is reliable, scalable, secure, cost-efficient and usable for detection, investigation, threat hunting and operational decision-making.
  
This is primarily a technical engineering role. The postholder will also act as a key technical contributor to platform strategy, roadmap, lifecycle, capacity, cost and vendor discussions. The role does not carry formal people-management accountability, but the postholder will be expected to provide technical leadership, mentor colleagues and lead complex engineering activity when required.
  
The position supports a critical production capability and includes participation in the team's standby/on-call rota.

**Key responsibilities**
========================

**1. End-to-end security telemetry engineering**
------------------------------------------------

* Design, build, operate and troubleshoot security telemetry pipelines from source systems through collection and processing platforms to storage, SIEM and downstream consumers.

* Engineer appropriate collection patterns for cloud, SaaS, on-premises, network, endpoint and application sources using technologies such as APIs, syslog/CEF, JSON, Event Hubs, Windows Event Collection and agent-based collection.

* Own complex onboarding and integration work end to end, including requirements, design, build, testing, production deployment, validation, documentation and transition into support.

* Diagnose failures across distributed pipelines and coordinate recovery across internal teams, platform providers and technology vendors.

* Ensure pipeline designs meet security, availability, performance, scalability and supportability requirements.

**2. Logging platform engineering**
-----------------------------------

* Provide hands-on engineering across Stream, Edge and Search, including routes, pipelines, functions, packs, event breaking, worker groups, fleet management, lookups and search use cases.

* Maintain platform health through monitoring, patching, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, capacity management, configuration control and performance tuning.

* Develop reusable patterns and automation that make onboarding, routing and operational support faster, safer and more consistent.

* Optimise data volumes and processing to improve platform efficiency and manage ingestion, storage and licensing costs without compromising agreed security outcomes.

* Support the controlled extension of Cribl capabilities to suitable data and observability use cases beyond traditional SIEM ingestion.

**3. SIEM and security consumer enablement**
--------------------------------------------

* Engineer and support integrations into SIEM and other approved destinations, including long-term storage and search platforms.

* Monitor source, dataset and destination health and resolve issues affecting data availability, completeness, timeliness or usability.

* Work with SOC, RADAR, detection engineering, threat hunting and incident response stakeholders to translate security use cases into clear telemetry requirements.

* Validate that onboarded data supports intended detection, investigation and hunting outcomes before declaring delivery complete.

* Maintain clear accountability boundaries: enable high-quality security data and platform capability while partnering with the relevant teams that own detection content and operational response.

**4. Data quality and data-as-a-product**
-----------------------------------------

* Apply and improve standards for parsing, normalisation, schema alignment, enrichment, filtering, metadata, routing and data validation.

* Ensure data is not merely ingested, but is understandable, trustworthy and actionable for its intended consumers.

* Define quality checks and acceptance criteria for new and changed sources, including completeness, field quality, timestamp handling, duplication, latency and routing accuracy.

* Create and maintain source ownership, design decisions, dependencies, support models and known limitations.

* Use customer feedback, operational evidence and platform metrics to improve the quality and value of security data products.

**5. Operational engineering and service reliability**
------------------------------------------------------

* Operate the logging and SIEM pipeline as a critical production capability, including health monitoring, incident response, problem management, root-cause analysis and service restoration.

* Plan and execute production changes, upgrades and releases in line with change-control requirements and with minimal disruption to dependent services.

* Develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, recovery procedures and support documentation.

* Contribute to resilience, continuity and recovery planning, and test that critical operational procedures work in practice.

* Participate in the standby/on-call rota and support major incidents or high-priority operational activity when required.

* Maintain clear operational metrics covering platform health, ingestion failures, source coverage, backlog, change success, patching, capacity, data quality, cost and risk.

**6. Platform strategy, lifecycle and vendor contribution**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Act as a key technical contributor to the strategy, roadmap and architectural evolution of the security logging, data pipeline and SIEM capability.

* Provide engineering input into lifecycle, capacity, licensing, cost forecasting, technical debt, supportability and investment decisions.

* Evaluate new features, integration patterns and technologies through structured technical assessment and proof of value.

* Work directly with strategic vendors and service partners to resolve technical issues, improve platform outcomes and influence product direction where appropriate.

* Identify operational or architectural risks early and provide clear options, recommendations and escalation paths to leadership.

**7. Technical leadership and capability uplift**
-------------------------------------------------

* Provide technical leadership without relying on formal line-management authority.

* Mentor engineers, review designs and implementations, and help colleagues build confidence in platform engineering, troubleshooting and operational practices.

* Lead complex engineering investigations and coordinate technical activity during high-impact changes or incidents.

* Promote shared ownership by establishing primary and secondary coverage for critical platform areas and reducing reliance on individual experts.

* Create reusable documentation, patterns and learning material so that successful solutions can be repeated consistently.

* Communicate progress, risks, dependencies and outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. **The Role**

**Your Role**  
Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  
  
In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  
  
**What You Will Do**  
Analyze and Solve
  

* Diagnose complex issues across servers, networks, cloud environments and systems to identify root causes
* Recommend solutions that balance technical feasibility, timelines and customer priorities
* Test, refine and automate processes to improve reliability, efficiency and repeatability
* Assess risks proactively and implement strategies to prevent disruptions

* Communicate technical solutions clearly to customers and stakeholders
* Build customer confidence by delivering tangible, high-impact results

  
Grow and Advance
  

* Expand technical expertise across cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems and emerging technologies
* Earn certifications and qualifications while applying them on real projects
* Pursue career paths toward Architect or Distinguished Engineer roles

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required skills and experience**  
  

* Deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics)

* Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain

**Preferred skills and experience**  
  

* Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures
* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models
* Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems
* Analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

title: Senior BIM Modeler Electrical
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

**Role Description:**  
Senior Electrical BIM Modeller will support the delivery of coordinated, accurate and information-rich Electrical BIM models and drawings for complex infrastructure and building projects, including projects with significant mechanical and multidisciplinary interfaces. The role will use Revit MEP and AutoCAD as primary authoring tools and Autodesk Forma / Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) for cloud-based collaboration, information exchange and issue management.

Working with Electrical Engineers, BIM Coordinators, BIM Managers and multidisciplinary design teams, the role will translate engineering information into compliant models and documentation, coordinate electrical systems with mechanical, architectural, structural and civil disciplines, and maintain model quality in accordance with the project BIM Execution Plan, client requirements, Arcadis standards and applicable information-management procedures. The role is expected to work  
with limited supervision, support junior modelers and take ownership of assigned modelling and  
documentation packages.

**Role Accountabilities:**

* Develop and maintain electrical BIM models for power distribution, lighting, small power, containment, earthing and lightning protection, emergency systems, communications, security, fire alarm and other electrical services applicable to the project scope.
* Produce coordinated plans, sections, elevations, schematics, schedules, details and drawing sheets from approved BIM models.  
  Model electrical systems to the agreed Level of Information Need, project stage and design responsibility, avoiding unnecessary over-modelling.
* Apply approved Revit templates, families, electrical system definitions, shared parameters, view templates, filters, worksets and naming conventions.
* Maintain technically valid models, including appropriate equipment locations, cable containment routes, access zones, clearances, interfaces and maintainability requirements.
* Single-Line Diagrams (SLD) & Equipment Integration: Translate complex electrical single-line diagrams into spatially coordinated 3D components and integrate them with continuous uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) and battery-bank frameworks.
* Extra-Low Voltage (ELV) Systems: Incorporate coordinated pathways and spatial provisions for instrumentation, building automation and control systems, fire alarm networks, security surveillance and associated ELV services.
* Substations & High-Voltage Infrastructure: Develop coordinated 3D layouts of step-down transformers, switchgear, main distribution panels and associated high-voltage infrastructure, incorporating access, clearance, maintenance and multidisciplinary interface requirements.
* Containment & Cable Tray Routing: Spatially model multi-tier cable trays, raceways and conduits, providing accurate pathway mapping for high-density facilities where extensive cable networks require precise routing, segregation, access and coordination.
* Coordinate electrical models with mechanical, public health, fire protection, architecture, structure, civil, utilities and other disciplines using linked and federated models.
* Identify clashes, design inconsistencies and missing information; communicate issues clearly and support timely resolution through agreed project workflows.
* Use Autodesk Forma / ACC for document management, design collaboration, model coordination, publishing, issue tracking, reviews and controlled information exchange.
* Prepare and update AutoCAD drawings where required, using correct layers, references, coordinates, title blocks and project drafting standards.
* Carry out model and drawing self-checks before review, respond to checker comments, and support project quality-assurance and model-health processes.
* Follow the BIM Execution Plan, task information delivery plan, Common Data Environment procedures, ISO 19650 principles and Arcadi's quality requirements.
* Support model setup, digital-delivery planning, drawing production, data drops and submissions in accordance with agreed programme and budget.
* Interpret engineering mark-ups, layouts, single-line diagrams, schematics, calculations, specifications and red-line comments and convert them into coordinated BIM outputs.
* Support BIM Coordinators and engineers during multidisciplinary reviews, clash-resolution sessions and model-coordination meetings.
* Provide task guidance, technical support and practical coaching to BIM Modelers and Trainee BIM Modelers.  
  Contribute to standardization, content-library development, lessons learned, communities of practice and continuous improvement of electrical BIM workflows.
* Take responsibility for personal health and safety and comply with applicable regulations, project requirements and Arcadis procedures.

**Required Qualifications and Experience:**

* Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Substantial relevant experience delivering electrical BIM models and drawings within an engineering consultancy, contractor or multidisciplinary design environment; typically, 4–7 years for a senior modeller role.
* Extensive experience working on infrastructure and building projects with complex mechanical, electrical and multidisciplinary interfaces, such as rail stations and depots, tunnels, aviation facilities, industrial plants, utilities, commercial buildings, healthcare facilities, data centres or similar assets.

title: Princ Engr-AI Science
description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing…**

As a Principal Engineer (Agentic & Applied AI), you will serve as a technical leader and individual performer, architecting and driving end-to-end solutions for complex AI and Agentic use cases across multiple concurrent projects. You will be hands-on in design and coding, while leading project pods with one or two junior engineers or data scientists.

* Leading the architecture, design, and end-to-end development of complex Agentic AI and traditional AI/ML solutions across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Working in a collaborative environment with global teams and managing cross-functional stakeholders across business and technical domains to deliver scalable solutions to high-impact business problems.
* Architecting, developing, and deploying LLM-driven applications, multi-agent workflows, autonomous agent systems, and traditional data science models into production environments.
* Translating complex business requirements into robust technical and system architectures, creating high-level and low-level design documents, and articulating architectural decisions and findings to leadership and stakeholders.
* Hands-on coding and system implementation using Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), REST/gRPC APIs, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka.
* Guiding, mentoring, and technical coaching of junior engineers and data scientists on project pods—conducting peer code and architecture reviews, sharing constructive feedback, and driving the team toward best-in-class technical execution
* Designing and implementing robust testing, validation, evaluation, and observability frameworks (e.g., LLM evals, hallucination mitigation, latency/token optimization, model governance) across the end-to-end AI lifecycle.
* Developing next-generation AI systems with built-in data privacy, ethical AI, bias mitigation, guardrails, and compliance with enterprise security and governance policies.
* Assisting in growing the AI practice by leading POCs, identifying new high-value opportunities, defining architectural blueprints, evaluating emerging tools/frameworks, and contributing to technical white papers and documentation.
* Staying informed on the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic frameworks, and related tech stacks, finding ways to deliver business value by customizing and applying them to our specific enterprise domain.
* Partnering with ecosystem partners, startups, and open-source communities to explore and integrate cutting-edge AI capabilities.

**What we’re looking for...**

You have deep technical expertise in modern AI engineering and traditional data science, and you thrive as a hands-on technical lead who bridges architecture, coding, and stakeholder collaboration. You are energized by working in a dynamic environment, handling multiple complex projects simultaneously, and translating ambiguous business problems into reliable, production-ready AI systems. You take pride in technical excellence, enjoy mentoring junior team members, and are passionate about advancing state-of-the-art Agentic and LLM architectures within an enterprise scale.

**What we're looking for… ("You'll need to have…")**

description:
**Company Description**

PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). title: PMTS - DFT Architect
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**PMTS SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER**

**THE ROLE:**

As a member of Circuit Technologies (CT) Team, you will architect, develop, and lead the DFT Design and Integration of cutting edge DFT structures including SCAN, ATPG, MBIST, BSCAN. In this role, you will work with the lead SoC/chiplet and IP architects to define future DFx architectures and contribute to product specifications, micro-architecture specifications, performance, and power trade-offs. The role will work from early concept development through the development phases to final production.

**THE PERSON:**

In this role, you will collaborate with a network of expert architects and designers around the world where collaboration and communication skills are critical to the success of this role, and excellent organization skills are essential. You will approach sophisticated problems with a firm methodology and problem-solving technique and conduct experiments and analysis to formulate recommendations and next steps for other colleagues, and SOC/chiplet and IP design teams located in across multiple time zones and geographies. You will formally present your findings to co-workers, teams, and customer engineering teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop next-generation SoC/chiplet and IP debug and observability solutions that enable secure, scalable, and robust silicon bring-up, validation, and post-silicon debug.
* Partner with architecture and SoC/chiplet and IP design teams to define and execute a comprehensive Design-for-Excellence (DFX) strategy spanning debug, test, validation, reliability, and manufacturability.
* Collaborate with technology, silicon validation, product engineering, and manufacturing teams to establish DFX architectures that support both functional operating modes and manufacturing test requirements.
* Drive cross-functional alignment on DFX requirements, use cases, and end-to-end implementation flows across AMD engineering organizations.
* Evaluate and deploy AI-driven methodologies to streamline DFX planning, insertion, verification, coverage analysis, and implementation, improving quality, consistency, and scalability while reducing manual effort and time-to-deployment.
* Define metrics, methodologies, and automation frameworks to ensure DFX solutions meet product quality, testability, debug, and production readiness objectives across multiple programs and technology generations.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* 10+ years of experience in SoC/chiplet and IP design, DFX architecture, or related silicon development disciplines.
* Strong understanding of DFX implementation and integration within complex, large-scale SoC/chiplet architectures.
* Deep knowledge of DFT methodologies and infrastructure, including scan, ATPG, MBIST, JTAG 1149.x/boundary scan, and advanced debug and test features.
* Solid understanding of SoC clocking, reset, power management, and low-power design architectures.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse engineering teams and disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to decompose complex technical problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop solutions from both architectural and implementation perspectives.
* Experience applying AI and data-driven techniques to improve engineering productivity, including DFX requirement analysis, insertion planning, verification, coverage assessment, validation, and design quality optimization.
* Ability to leverage modern AI-assisted engineering workflows and tools to accelerate debug, reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and enable earlier identification of design and DFX risks.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

* Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering

title: Renewable Energy/Solar Engineer
description:
Renewable Energy Engineer / Renewable Energy Project & Business Manager

**Location:** Kingdom of Bahrain  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Minimum Experience:** 10+ Years of Relevant Experience  
**Industry:** Renewable Energy, Solar PV, Electrical Contracting and Energy Solutions  
**Reporting To:** Management / CEO

1. Position Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced, technically competent and commercially oriented Renewable Energy Engineer / Manager to establish, develop and manage our upcoming renewable energy business in the Kingdom of Bahrain.

The ideal candidate must possess a minimum of 10 years of solid, hands-on experience and comprehensive knowledge of the entire renewable energy business lifecycle, particularly solar photovoltaic (PV) systems, electrical installations, engineering, procurement, construction (EPC), project management, operations and maintenance (O&M), and business development.

The candidate must be capable of independently managing the complete 360° cycle of renewable energy operations, from initial business development and feasibility studies through engineering, costing, tendering, regulatory approvals, procurement, installation, commissioning, customer handover and long-term maintenance.

The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing the technical and operational framework, developing the customer base, building supplier and contractor relationships, coordinating the relevant licensing requirements and ensuring sustainable business growth and profitability.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Renewable Energy Business Development — End-to-End Management**

* Lead the development and establishment of the company's renewable energy and solar power business in Bahrain.
* Identify and develop opportunities in residential, commercial, industrial, institutional and other suitable market segments.
* Develop relationships with customers, consultants, contractors, developers, facility management companies and government or private-sector stakeholders.
* Conduct customer meetings, site assessments, technical presentations and solution proposals.
* Develop annual business plans, sales strategies, revenue forecasts and project pipelines.
* Support management in evaluating market potential, competitor activities, pricing strategies and business expansion opportunities.

**B. Technical Engineering and System Design**

* Conduct site surveys, energy assessments, load analysis, feasibility studies and solar resource assessments.
* Design and develop grid-connected solar PV systems and, where relevant, hybrid and battery energy storage solutions.
* Prepare preliminary and detailed engineering designs, system layouts, single-line diagrams, cable sizing, protection schemes and equipment specifications.
* Select appropriate solar modules, inverters, mounting structures, cables, switchgear, protection devices and monitoring systems.
* Perform energy-yield estimates, generation forecasts, system performance calculations and financial feasibility assessments.
* Ensure that proposed systems meet applicable technical standards, grid-connection requirements, safety requirements and project specifications.

**C. Feasibility Studies, Costing, Tendering and Commercial Management**

* Prepare detailed BOQs, material take-offs, technical specifications, cost estimates and project budgets.
* Develop competitive customer quotations, tenders, commercial proposals and technical submissions.
* Evaluate project capital expenditure, operating expenditure, payback periods, return on investment and lifecycle costs.
* Assess project profitability, margins, payment terms, contractual risks and commercial viability.
* Coordinate with suppliers, manufacturers, distributors and subcontractors to obtain competitive prices and suitable technical solutions.
* Review customer contracts, tender documents, scope of work, exclusions, warranties and contractual deliverables.

**D. Regulatory Approvals, Licensing and Compliance in Bahrain**

* Coordinate with the relevant Bahrain authorities for CR activity amendments, electrical contracting licences and renewable energy contractor registration.
* Work closely with the Electricity and Water Authority (EWA), relevant engineering consultants and other authorities on applicable approval procedures.
* Coordinate solar PV contractor qualification, required technical personnel certifications, project submissions, inspections and grid-connection approvals.
* Ensure that project designs, installations and documentation comply with applicable Bahrain regulations, electrical codes, safety requirements and approved specifications.
* Maintain records of licences, approvals, technical certificates, inspection reports and compliance documentation.

The candidate must be capable of coordinating the approval process and identifying the technical and personnel requirements. Any regulated design, certification, approval or contracting activity must be undertaken by appropriately qualified and authorized personnel.

**E. Procurement, Supply Chain and Vendor Management**

* Develop and maintain a reliable supplier and subcontractor network for solar PV equipment and related electrical materials.
* Prepare procurement schedules aligned with approved project programmes and budgets.
* Evaluate technical compliance, pricing, delivery schedules, product quality and warranty conditions.
* Negotiate supplier terms and coordinate material availability, logistics, delivery and inventory planning.
* Verify material specifications, certificates, warranties and compliance with approved technical submissions.
* Manage supplier performance, material quality issues and procurement-related risks.

**F. Project Execution, Installation and Commissioning**

* Manage the complete project lifecycle from award and mobilisation through installation, testing, commissioning and handover.
* Prepare project execution plans, work schedules, resource plans, method statements and installation programmes.
* Supervise engineers, technicians, installation teams, subcontractors and site activities.
* Coordinate civil works, mounting structures, module installation, electrical cabling, inverters, protection systems, earthing and grid-interface works.
* Monitor project progress, quality, productivity, costs and deadlines.
* Coordinate inspections, testing, commissioning, performance verification and rectification of defects.
* Ensure that projects are delivered safely, within budget, on schedule and in accordance with approved specifications.

**G. Operations, Maintenance and After-Sales Service**

* Develop preventive and corrective maintenance programmes for installed renewable energy systems.
* Establish procedures for performance monitoring, fault diagnosis, troubleshooting and breakdown response.
* Monitor energy generation, system availability, inverter performance and overall plant efficiency.
* Coordinate warranty claims, spare parts, repairs, technical support and customer complaints.
* Develop annual maintenance contracts and long-term customer service arrangements.
* Prepare performance reports and recommend improvements to system reliability and energy yield.

**H. Team Leadership and Operational Management**

* Establish the technical, operational and project management procedures required for the new business.
* Recruit, train, supervise and develop engineers, technicians, project personnel and subcontractors.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor performance and establish clear accountability.
* Implement standard operating procedures for engineering, estimation, procurement, execution, quality and maintenance.
* Coordinate with management, finance, procurement, sales and administration teams.
* Prepare periodic management reports covering sales pipeline, project status, costs, profitability, risks and operational performance.

**I. Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Compliance**

* Implement appropriate health and safety procedures for electrical and solar installation work.
* Ensure safe working practices for work at height, electrical isolation, testing, commissioning and other site activities.
* Prepare and review risk assessments, method statements, inspection plans and quality documentation.
* Monitor installation quality, workmanship, equipment compliance and corrective actions.
* Promote energy efficiency, environmental responsibility and continuous improvement throughout project delivery.

3. Essential Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Renewable Energy Engineering or an equivalent relevant discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of substantial, hands-on experience in renewable energy, with strong emphasis on solar PV systems and electrical contracting.
* Proven experience managing the complete 360° renewable energy lifecycle, including business development, feasibility, engineering, costing, procurement, installation, commissioning and maintenance.
* Demonstrable experience in managing solar PV projects from initial customer enquiry through final handover and after-sales support.
* Strong technical knowledge of solar modules, inverters, electrical protection, grid integration, system monitoring and energy storage where applicable.
* Extensive experience in BOQ preparation, estimation, tendering, project budgeting, supplier negotiation and commercial management.
* Proven ability to manage project teams, subcontractors, suppliers, customer relationships, budgets and project schedules.
* Strong knowledge of electrical safety, quality assurance, technical documentation and project risk management.
* Proficiency in relevant engineering and project management software, such as AutoCAD, PVsyst, PV\*SOL, Microsoft Excel and project scheduling tools, as applicable.

4. Preferred Qualifications and Experience

* Previous experience in the GCC, particularly Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Oman or Kuwait.
* Familiarity with EWA requirements and Bahrain's solar PV approval and grid-connection procedures.
* Experience working with solar EPC contractors, electrical contractors, renewable energy developers or energy service companies.
* Experience in commercial and industrial rooftop installations and larger ground-mounted solar projects.
* Exposure to battery energy storage systems, hybrid systems, energy audits, energy efficiency and power quality.
* Relevant professional registrations, technical certifications or renewable energy training.
* Experience developing new business units, establishing operational procedures and achieving commercial targets.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed against measurable objectives, including:

* Successful establishment of the renewable energy business and completion of applicable licensing and approval requirements.
* Development of a qualified sales pipeline and achievement of agreed sales and revenue targets.
* Conversion rate of enquiries, tenders and quotations into profitable projects.
* Accuracy of project estimates and adherence to approved gross margins and budgets.
* On-time project delivery and compliance with approved technical specifications.
* Quality of installation, commissioning, documentation and customer handover.
* Customer satisfaction, repeat business and after-sales service performance.
* Development of reliable suppliers, subcontractors and technical resources.
* Effectiveness of operations and maintenance services and response to technical issues.
* Compliance with safety, quality, regulatory and reporting requirements.

Specific targets will be agreed with management based on the approved business plan, project pipeline and available resources.

6. Personal Competencies

The candidate must demonstrate:

* Strong technical judgement and practical problem-solving ability.
* Commercial awareness and a clear understanding of project profitability.
* Leadership, accountability and independent decision-making.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and customer management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* A proactive approach to business development and market expansion.
* Strong organisational, analytical and reporting skills.
* Willingness to relocate to Bahrain and build a renewable energy business from its establishment stage.

7. Expected Outcome

The successful candidate will be expected to establish a technically sound, commercially viable and operationally efficient renewable energy business, capable of delivering solar PV and related energy solutions from initial customer engagement through engineering, procurement, installation, commissioning and long-term maintenance.

The candidate must function as both a senior technical professional and an operational business leader, taking ownership of project delivery, customer satisfaction, regulatory coordination, team performance and sustainable business growth.

8. Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit:

* An updated CV detailing at least 10 years of relevant experience.
* Educational qualifications and relevant professional certifications.
* A list of major renewable energy projects handled, including capacity, scope, role and responsibilities.
* Details of experience in solar EPC, electrical contracting, tendering, project costing and commissioning.
* Details of GCC experience and familiarity with Bahrain or EWA requirements, where applicable.
* Current location, current compensation, expected monthly salary, notice period and availability to relocate to Bahrain.

**Candidates with proven end-to-end renewable energy project and business management experience will be prioritised.**

Pay: ₹150,000.00 - ₹250,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 2+ years of relevant professional experience in software development.
* Experience owning features or components within a service or application from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and support.
* Proficiency in software development, API integration, data modeling, version control, automated testing, debugging, and production support.
Familiarity with low-level system design and developing maintainable, reliable, secure, and operationally resilient software solutions, as well as AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience delivering software products at scale with a focus on performance, accessibility, usability, security, and operational excellence.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and production insights to make technical decisions, diagnose complex issues, and improve the reliability and maintainability of production applications.
* Experience contributing to architecture and design decisions across multiple services or technical domains while collaborating effectively with partner teams.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools or applying AI/ML concepts to improve product capabilities, engineering workflows, or customer outcomes.
Experience safely integrating, monitoring, and operating AI/ML-enabled features within software applications, with attention to reliability, governance, and measurable impact.  

  

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient.
